161	# Submission Instructions
162	
163	## Submission Method Upgrade
164	To provide participants with higher freedom, we have upgraded the submission method—participants can now freely customize the runtime environment and model preprocessing workflow.
165	
166	## Submission Requirements
167	Participants need to package all codes and resources into a `.tar.gz` file, which must contain:
168	
169	| File | Required | Description |
170	| :--- | :--- | :--- |
171	| `prepare_env.sh` | Required | Environment build script |
172	| `prepare_model.sh` | Optional | Model preprocessing script |
173	| Other code/resources | As needed | Organized by participants |
174	
175	## Execution Process
176	1. **Environment Build**: After the platform starts the base environment, it will automatically execute the `prepare_env.sh` provided by the participant to install the dependencies and configurations required by the participant on top of the base environment.
177	2. **Model Preprocessing (if provided)**: After the environment is ready, the platform will call `prepare_model.sh` to process the original model and output it to the specified path for subsequent inference phase use.
178	
179	`prepare_model.sh` must support the following two parameters:
180	```bash
181	bash prepare_model.sh --input <original model path> --output <processed model path>
182	```
183	
184	| Parameter | Description |
185	| :--- | :--- |
186	| `--input` | The original model path provided by the platform, the script reads the model from this path |
187	| `--output` | The output path specified by the platform, the script must write the processed model to this path |
188	
189	## Notes
190	- The base environment uses `uv` as the package manager. When executing operations like `pip install`, please use `uv pip install` instead, and be sure to fully test locally before submitting.
191	- **Migration Hint for Old Submission Method**: Participants who previously submitted using the wheel package method, please adapt the original logic to the new `prepare_env.sh` + `prepare_model.sh` method. For example, migrate the installation command of the wheel to `prepare_env.sh` for execution, and the original model processing logic can be migrated to `prepare_model.sh`. The old wheel submission method will no longer be supported.
192	
193	# Submission Demo
194	
195	Download Link: [demo-sala.tar.gz](demos/demo-sala.tar.gz)
196	
197	This directory is a minimal runnable submission example, demonstrating how to organize the `prepare_env.sh` + `prepare_model.sh` submission package according to platform requirements.
198	
199	## Directory Structure
200	```
201	├── prepare_env.sh          # Required — Environment build script
202	├── prepare_model.sh        # Optional — Model preprocessing entry
203	├── preprocess_model.py     # Python script called by prepare_model.sh
204	└── sglang/python/          # Custom sglang source code (editable install)
205	```
206	
207	## File Descriptions
208	
209	### prepare_env.sh (Required)
210	The platform automatically executes this script after the base environment starts. This demo does two things:
211	1. Use `uv pip install --no-deps -e ./sglang/python` to install custom sglang in editable mode, replacing the built-in version in the image.
212	2. Append inference startup parameters via `export SGLANG_SERVER_ARGS` (example adds `--log-level info`).
213	
214	```bash
215	uv pip install --no-deps -e ./sglang/python
216	export SGLANG_SERVER_ARGS="${SGLANG_SERVER_ARGS:-} --log-level info"
217	```
218	> Note: `prepare_env.sh` will be sourced into the platform main script, so exported environment variables can take effect directly.
219	
220	### prepare_model.sh (Optional)
221	The platform calls this script after the environment is ready, the interface is fixed as:
222	```bash
223	bash prepare_model.sh --input <original model path> --output <processed model path>
224	```
225	Both paths are provided by the platform, and participants do not need to care about the specific mount location in the container. This demo only does simple model file copying without any quantization or conversion.
226	In actual competition, you can implement preprocessing logic such as quantization (GPTQ, AWQ, etc.), pruning, weight fusion, etc. in `preprocess_model.py`.
227	
228	### sglang/python/
229	Custom sglang source code directory. Through editable install, the platform will use the code in this directory to replace the built-in sglang in the image, and participants can modify the implementation of the inference engine here.
230	
231	## Extension Examples
232	
233	| Scenario | Modification Point |
234	| :--- | :--- |
235	| Install extra pip packages | Add `uv pip install xxx` in `prepare_env.sh` |
236	| Custom inference parameters | Modify `SGLANG_SERVER_ARGS` in `prepare_env.sh` |
237	| GPTQ Quantization | Implement GPTQ packaging in `preprocess_model.py`, append `--quantization gptq` in `prepare_env.sh` |
238	| Model Pruning/Distillation | Implement in `preprocess_model.py`, output to `--output` directory |
239	
240	# Technical Path Guidance
241	
242	This competition encourages participants to explore optimization around model inference performance, including but not limited to technical directions such as quantization compression and speculative sampling. To facilitate participants' understanding and practice, we provide the following two reference technical ideas.
243	
244	## Path 1: Quantization Acceleration
245	**Optional Path: GPTQ W4A16 + Marlin Kernel + FP8 KV Cache**
246	
247	Quantize model weights to 4-bit (W4A16), use Marlin high-performance dequantization GEMM Kernel to accelerate Linear calculation; Quantize KV Cache to FP8 to reduce video memory bandwidth bottleneck in Decode phase. The quantization tool (GPTQModel) works out of the box, SGLang has perfect support for GPTQ + Marlin, and participants only need to submit the quantization script to quantize on the evaluation machine on site.
248	
249	**Workflow:**
250	1. **Write Quantization Script**: Use GPTQModel to perform W4A16 quantization (group_size=128) on SALA FP16 weights, and the script serves as a submission.
251	2. **Verify Correctness**: Start with `--quantization gptq_marlin`, confirm accuracy > 97%; if the drop is severe, fallback to W8.
252	3. **Enable KV Cache FP8**: `--kv-cache-dtype fp8_e5m2`, significant benefits in long context scenarios. Note that Lightning Attention layer uses independent linear attention state, optimization path is different.
253	4. **Advanced Tuning**: Adjust Marlin Kernel's tile / warp configuration for 6000D.
254	
255	**Core files that may need reading and modification:**
256	- **Model and Loading**
257	  - `python/sglang/srt/models/minicpm_sala.py` — SALA model definition
258	  - `python/sglang/srt/model_loader/loader.py`, `weight_utils.py` — Weight loading and quantization mapping
259	  - `python/sglang/srt/server_args.py` — Startup parameters (`--quantization`, `--kv-cache-dtype`)
260	- **Quantization Methods**
261	  - `python/sglang/srt/layers/quantization/gptq.py` — GPTQ linear layer and Marlin scheduling
262	  - `python/sglang/srt/layers/quantization/__init__.py` — Quantization method registry
263	  - `python/sglang/srt/layers/linear.py` — Main Linear layer, quantization method injection point
264	- **CUDA Operators**
265	  - `sgl-kernel/csrc/gemm/marlin/gptq_marlin.cu`, `marlin_template.h` — Marlin W4A16 GEMM Kernel
266	  - `sgl-kernel/csrc/gemm/gptq/gptq_kernel.cu` — GPTQ dequantization Kernel
267	- **KV Cache Quantization**
268	  - `python/sglang/srt/layers/quantization/kv_cache.py` — KV Cache quantization logic
269	
270	## Path 2: Speculative Sampling
271	**Optional Path: EAGLE3 Multi-layer Draft Head (Requires Algorithm Innovation)**
272	
273	EAGLE3 uses a lightweight Draft Head to predict candidate tokens using the target model's hidden states, and then validates them all at once by the target model. The Head parameter size is extremely small (tens of MB), meeting the 2GB limit.
274	
275	**Lightning Attention Compatibility Challenge**: Some layers of SALA use Lightning Attention (Gated Delta Rule linear attention), whose recursive calculation essentially does not support tree-like causal masks, so the traditional tree verification mechanism cannot take effect directly. SGLang has preliminary integration (`is_target_verify` mode is handled in `hybrid_linear_attn_backend.py`), but participants may still need to innovate at the algorithm level, and innovative solutions are encouraged.
276	
277	**Workflow:**
278	1. **Train EAGLE3 Head**: Refer to the EAGLE repository, use SALA to collect hidden states to train Draft Head, weights as submission.
279	2. **Model Adaptation**: Refer to `llama_eagle3.py` to create EAGLE3 model file for SALA.
280	3. **Solve Lightning Attention Verification Problem**: Core difficulty, need to modify verification logic to adapt to linear attention layer.
281	4. **Start Verification**: `--speculative-algorithm EAGLE3 --speculative-draft-model-path <path> --speculative-num-draft-tokens 5`.
282	
283	**Core files that may need reading and modification:**
284	- **EAGLE3 Pipeline**
285	  - `python/sglang/srt/speculative/multilayer_eagleworker.py` — EAGLE3 Draft Worker main loop
286	  - `python/sglang/srt/speculative/eagle_utils.py` — Tree mask construction and Verify function (key point for adapting linear attention)
287	  - `python/sglang/srt/speculative/eagle_info.py` — Verify / Draft data structure
288	  - `python/sglang/srt/speculative/multi_layer_eagle_utils.py` — EAGLE3 Triton Kernel
289	- **Model Adaptation**
290	  - `python/sglang/srt/models/llama_eagle3.py` — Reference template: LLaMA EAGLE3 implementation
291	  - `python/sglang/srt/models/minicpm_sala.py` — SALA target model (need to create EAGLE3 version based on this)
292	- **Lightning Attention (Key to understanding verification compatibility)**
293	  - `python/sglang/srt/layers/attention/hybrid_linear_attn_backend.py` — Hybrid linear attention Backend (preliminary spec integration exists)
294	  - `python/sglang/srt/layers/radix_linear_attention.py` — Linear attention layer interface
295	  - `python/sglang/srt/layers/attention/fla/chunk.py`, `fused_recurrent.py` — Linear attention Triton Kernel
296	  - `python/sglang/jit_kernel/cutedsl_gdn.py` — GDN CUDA Kernel
297	- **CUDA Operators**
298	  - `sgl-kernel/csrc/speculative/eagle_utils.cu` — Tree construction + Verify Kernel
299	  - `sgl-kernel/csrc/speculative/speculative_sampling.cu` — Sampling Kernel

```
1	import logging
2	from typing import Union
3	
4	from fastapi import Request
5	
6	from sglang.srt.entrypoints.openai.protocol import (
7	    ErrorResponse,
8	    ScoringRequest,
9	    ScoringResponse,
10	)
11	from sglang.srt.entrypoints.openai.serving_base import OpenAIServingBase
12	
13	logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
14	
15	
16	class OpenAIServingScore(OpenAIServingBase):
17	    """Handler for /v1/score requests"""
18	
19	    # NOTE: /v1/rerank is not an official OpenAI endpoint. This module may be moved
20	    # to another module in the future.
21	
22	    def _request_id_prefix(self) -> str:
23	        return "score-"
24	
25	    def _convert_to_internal_request(
26	        self,
27	        request: ScoringRequest,
28	        raw_request: Request = None,
29	    ) -> tuple[ScoringRequest, ScoringRequest]:
30	        """Convert OpenAI scoring request to internal format"""
31	        # For scoring, we pass the request directly as the tokenizer_manager
32	        # has a specialized score_request method that doesn't use GenerateReqInput
33	
34	        return request, request
35	
36	    async def _handle_non_streaming_request(
37	        self,
38	        adapted_request: ScoringRequest,
39	        request: ScoringRequest,
40	        raw_request: Request,
41	    ) -> Union[ScoringResponse, ErrorResponse]:
42	        """Handle the scoring request"""
43	        try:
44	            # Use tokenizer_manager's score_request method directly
45	            scores = await self.tokenizer_manager.score_request(
46	                query=request.query,
47	                items=request.items,
48	                label_token_ids=request.label_token_ids,
49	                apply_softmax=request.apply_softmax,
50	                item_first=request.item_first,
51	                request=raw_request,
52	            )
53	
54	            # Create response with just the scores, without usage info
55	            response = ScoringResponse(
56	                scores=scores,
57	                model=request.model,
58	            )
59	            return response
60	
61	        except ValueError as e:
62	            return self.create_error_response(str(e))
63
```

1	# EAGLE-3 Speculative Decoding for MiniCPM-SALA
2	
3	## 1. 概述
4	
5	EAGLE-3 是当前的核心加速方向，用于替代 Medusa K=1。管线已完整：数据采集、训练、模型转换、SGLang 集成均已实现并验证，服务器运行稳定，回答正常。
6	
7	**当前状态**：
8	- 在线 accept_len: 1.50（单请求）/ 1.33（32 并发）— epoch 1 checkpoint
9	- OOD accept rate: 49.3%（epoch 4 后饱和）
10	- Medusa 可比指标: 37% accept rate, 1.377 tok/step
11	
12	## 2. Aux Layer 选择
13	
14	### 选定: [1, 10, 22]
15	
16	| Layer | 深度 | 类型 | 选择理由 |
17	|-------|------|------|----------|
18	| 1 | 早期 (第 2 层) | Lightning Attention | Token identity + 位置 + 初步上下文 |
19	| 10 | 中期 (第 11 层) | Lightning Attention | 中间语义，已过 2 次 StdAttn + 9 次 Lightning |
20	| 22 | 中后期 (第 23 层) | Standard Attention | 接近最终语义，单独预测力最强 |
21	
22	### 实验支持
23	
24	Linear probe（wikitext-2, 64 samples × 2048 tokens, 200 steps）：
25	
26	```
27	[1, 10, 22] CE=6.51  ★ Best
28	[2, 9, 22]  CE=6.57
29	[2, 10, 21] CE=6.64
30	[2, 10, 22] CE=6.68
31	```
32	
33	**与 EAGLE-3 官方的差异**：官方用 [emb, layer0, layer1]（极早期）。MiniCPM-SALA 的 `scale_depth=1.4/sqrt(32)=0.247` 使早期层之间高度相似，all-early 会浪费 fc 容量。early + mid + late 信息互补更优。
34	
35	## 3. Draft Model 架构
36	
37	```
38	Eagle3Model (~437M trainable):
39	  fc:        Linear(12288 → 4096, bias=False)     # 50M, 融合 3 层 aux hidden
40	  midlayer:  Eagle3DecoderLayer                    # 完整 decoder layer
41	    hidden_norm:    RMSNorm(4096)
42	    input_emb_norm: RMSNorm(4096)
43	    self_attn:      Eagle3Attention (GQA 32h/2kv)
44	      q_proj: Linear(8192 → 4096)   # 输入 = cat(normed_embed, normed_hidden)
45	      k_proj: Linear(8192 → 256)
46	      v_proj: Linear(8192 → 256)
47	      o_proj: Linear(4096 → 4096)
48	    post_attention_layernorm: RMSNorm(4096)
49	    mlp: SwiGLU
50	      gate_proj: Linear(4096 → 16384)
51	      up_proj:   Linear(4096 → 16384)
52	      down_proj: Linear(16384 → 4096)
53	  norm:         RMSNorm(4096)
54	  embed_tokens: Embedding(73448, 4096) [FROZEN, from target]
55	  lm_head:      Linear(4096 → 32000)              # 32K draft 词表
56	```
57	
58	**词表映射**：从训练数据高频 token 选取 32K 子集。`d2t` 映射 draft→full vocab。OOD 覆盖率 97%（不在词表的位置在 accept rate 计算中被 mask）。
59	
60	**与 Medusa 对比**：
61	
62	| | Medusa K=1 | EAGLE-3 |
63	|---|---|---|
64	| 可训练参数 | 33.6M (65MB) | 437M (1.4GB safetensors) |
65	| 架构 | 纯前馈 (2×ResBlock) | 完整 decoder layer (GQA attn + SwiGLU MLP) |
66	| 输入 | 单层 hidden state (4096) | 3 层 aux hidden concat (12288) |
67	| 词表 | 完整 73,448 (共享 lm_head) | 32K draft 子集 (独立 lm_head) |
68	| draft 能力 | 无 token 间依赖 | 有 attention 建模序列依赖 |
69	
70	## 4. 数据采集
71	
72	### 采集机制
73	
74	`minicpm.py` 内置 hook，通过环境变量 `EAGLE3_COLLECT_DIR` 激活。每次 EXTEND forward 捕获 layer 1, 10, 22 的 **MLP delta 输出**（不含 residual）+ top-256 logits。
75	
76	### 数据格式 (.pt per sample)
77	
78	```python
79	{
80	    "token_ids":         (seq_len,),        # int64
81	    "aux_hidden":        (seq_len, 12288),  # bf16, cat(layer1, layer10, layer22)
82	    "top_logit_values":  (seq_len, 256),    # bf16
83	    "top_logit_indices": (seq_len, 256),    # int32
84	}
85	```
86	
87	### 训练数据
88	
89	| 来源 | 比例 | 样本数 | 备注 |
90	|------|------|--------|------|
91	| SkyPile (中文网页) | 50% | 5000 | `/user_4813494d/data/skypile/` |
92	| Code (code_search_net) | 42% | 4200 | py60/java16/go12/js8/php2.4/ruby1.6 |
93	| Wikitext-103 (英文) | 8% | 800 | — |
94	
95	- 每样本截断到 2048 tokens，共 11,611 个 .pt 文件 (~475 GB)
96	- val_ood: 64 samples from `bench/data/speed_bench_cunlimited.jsonl`（模型生成的长文本，无截断）
97	
98	## 5. 训练
99	
100	### 关键对齐：Shifted Alignment
101	
102	SGLang 推理时 EAGLE-3 的输入是 **(x_{t+1}, aux[t])** → 预测 **x_{t+2}**（`eagle_info.py` 中隐式左移 input_ids）。训练必须匹配：
103	
104	```python
105	input_ids   = token_ids[:, 1:]           # x_1..x_{S-1}
106	aux_shifted = aux_hidden[:, :-1, :]      # aux_0..aux_{S-2}
107	target      = target_logits[:, 1:, :]    # 对应位置的 target 分布
108	```
109	
110	**修复前**（旧代码用未 shifted 的对齐）：OOD accept rate = 8.2%，在线 accept_len ≈ 1.05。**修复后**：epoch 1 即达到 35.5% OOD / 1.50 在线 accept_len。
111	
112	### 训练配置
113	
114	```
115	TTT_STEPS   = 1       # 单步（足够 spec decode，多步未实现）
116	BATCH_SIZE  = 2
117	GRAD_ACCUM  = 4       # effective batch = 8
118	LR          = 3e-4
119	WARMUP      = 500 steps
120	EPOCHS      = 10
121	SEQ_LEN     = 2048
122	WEIGHT_DECAY = 0.0
123	LOSS        = plogp: -sum(target_p * log(draft_p))
124	```
125	
126	### 训练结果
127	
128	| Epoch | Train Loss | Train Acc0 | OOD Accept Rate |
129	|-------|-----------|-----------|----------------|
130	| 1 | 4.59 | 34.3% | 35.5% |
131	| 2 | 2.85 | 53.9% | 45.8% |
132	| 3 | 2.41 | 61.9% | 49.1% |
133	| **4** | **2.15** | **67.6%** | **49.3% (饱和)** |
134	| 10 | 1.45 | 89.6% | ~49% (过拟合) |
135	
136	`best.pt` = epoch_4（OOD 最优）。`sglang_model/` 已从 epoch_4 转换。
137	
138	### OOD 饱和分析
139	
140	- 训练分布 vs OOD 分布差异大：OOD 100% 中文 + 67% CoT 推理，训练 50% 中文 + 42% 代码
141	- 零正则化（WEIGHT_DECAY=0, 无 dropout, 训练中未实现 OOD early stopping）
142	- Target 模型在 OOD 上 greedy top-1 正确率 65.9%（理论上限），49.3% = 上限的 74.8%
143	
144	## 6. SGLang 适配与修复
145	
146	### 6.1 Target Model 捕获 (`minicpm.py`)
147	
148	`MiniCPMModel.forward` 增加 `layers_to_capture` set。在指定层迭代开始前捕获 hidden_states（MLP delta），forward 返回 `(hidden_states, aux_hidden_states)` tuple。通过 `set_eagle3_layers_to_capture(layer_ids)` 配置，`+1` 对齐因为迭代 i 开始时 hidden_states 是 layer i-1 的输出。
149	
150	### 6.2 EAGLE-3 兼容性修复 (commit `8bc05a3`)
151	
152	四个关键修复解决了 EAGLE-3 在 MiniCPM-SALA 上的运行问题：
153	
154	**1. GLA state rollback 修复**
155	- 问题：`eagle_worker.py` 用 `hybrid_gdn_config/mamba2_config` 判断是否需要回滚，遗漏了 MiniCPM-SALA 的 `minicpm_hybrid_config`
156	- 修复：统一使用 `mambaish_config`（包含所有变体）
157	
158	**2. Sparse k1/k2 slot 分配**
159	- 问题：MiniCPM-SALA 使用 InfLLM-v2 sparse attention，正常 decode 在 `alloc_for_decode` 中分配 sparse slots，但 EAGLE 跳过该路径
160	- 修复：新增 `_alloc_sparse_for_new_positions()`，在 verify 后手动分配 k1/k2 slots
161	
162	**3. Draft model 配置隔离**
163	- 问题：draft model 是 BF16 Llama 小模型，但继承了 target 的 NVFP4 量化设置和 minicpm_flashinfer attention backend
164	- 修复：初始化时临时将 `speculative_draft_model_quantization` 置 None；target 用 `minicpm_flashinfer` 时自动将 draft 切换为 `flashinfer`
165	
166	**4. KV cache slot 释放时序**
167	- 问题：draft 阶段分配 `num_seqs × steps × topk` 个 token slot，`prepare_for_verify` 覆盖 `out_cache_loc` 后这些 slot 成为孤儿
168	- 修复：在 `verify()` 开头、`prepare_for_verify` 之前释放 draft slots
169	
170	### 6.3 model_runner / cuda_graph_runner 修复
171	
172	- `set_eagle3_layers_to_capture` 调用现在正确传入 `eagle_aux_hidden_state_layer_ids`，而非 fallback 到默认值
173	- cuda_graph_runner 在 EAGLE3 模式下也正确调用 `set_eagle3_layers_to_capture(layer_ids)`
174	
175	### 6.4 Medusa CUDA graph 双模式
176	
177	为支持 Medusa 的 BS_THRESHOLD fallback，实现了 TARGET_VERIFY 和 DECODE 双模式 CUDA graph：
178	- graph key 区分：`bs`（TARGET_VERIFY）vs `decode_{bs}`（DECODE）
179	- `minicpm_backend.py` metadata 存储/查找做对应双模式处理
180	- `schedule_batch.py` 新增 `prepare_sparse_metadata_for_decode()` 给 no-spec fallback 路径
181	
182	## 7. Tree Verify 与 GLA 兼容性
183	
184	### 问题
185	
186	24/32 层 GLA（线性注意力）在 TARGET_VERIFY 时逐 token 串行处理，所有 draft tokens 当线性序列。topk>1 时不同分支的 state 互相污染。8 层 Standard Attention 使用 tree mask，正确。
187	
188	### topk=2 仍优于 topk=1
189	
190	实测 topk=2 更快，原因：
191	- 6 个候选 vs 3 个，覆盖率优势 > GLA 污染损失
192	- 8 层 standard attention 的 tree mask 正确，部分补偿 GLA 误差
193	- GLA 污染有界——sibling branch 扰动不至于完全破坏 logits
194	
195	### 可能改进
196	
197	DFS 遍历 + state 分支保存：GLA 层在分支点保存 state，处理完一条路径后 restore。每分支点 ~1 MB/层，24层×3点=72 MB，计算量不变。
198	
199	## 8. 模型转换 (`eagle/convert_to_sglang.py`)
200	
201	训练 checkpoint → SGLang `LlamaForCausalLMEagle3` 格式：
202	
203	- 键名重映射（`fc.weight` → `model.fc.weight`，`input_emb_norm` → `input_layernorm` 等）
204	- `d2t` 以 diff 存储：`d2t_stored = d2t - arange(32000)`，SGLang 端重建
205	- `embed_tokens.weight` 从 target 模型新加载（frozen，不在训练 checkpoint 中）
206	- 输出 `eagle/sglang_model/`：`model.safetensors` (1.4 GB) + `config.json` + tokenizer
207	
208	当前转换的是 epoch_4 checkpoint。
209	
210	## 9. 文件结构
211	
212	```
213	eagle/
214	├── collect_data.py          # 数据采集脚本
215	├── train.py                 # 训练脚本 (shifted alignment)
216	├── convert_to_sglang.py     # checkpoint → sglang 格式转换
217	├── eval_ood_accept.py       # 离线 OOD accept rate 评估
218	├── test_eagle3_flow.py      # 单元测试
219	├── test_forward_match.py    # prefill/decode 一致性测试
220	├── test_decode_mode.py      # position-by-position decode 测试
221	├── test_offline_pred.py     # fc→norm→lm_head 简化诊断
222	├── verify_sglang_draft.py   # safetensors 权重验证
223	├── data/
224	│   ├── train/               # 11,611 个 .pt 文件 (~475 GB)
225	│   └── vocab_cache.pt       # 32K 词表映射缓存
226	├── weights/
227	│   ├── epoch_{1..10}.pt     # 训练 checkpoint (各 2.5 GB)
228	│   ├── best.pt              # = epoch_4 (OOD 最优)
229	│   └── best_unshifted.pt    # 旧未 shifted 版 (仅存档)
230	└── sglang_model/            # 转换后的 SGLang 格式 (1.4 GB)
231	    ├── model.safetensors
232	    ├── config.json
233	    └── tokenizer*
234	```
235	
236	## 10. 已排除的假设
237	
238	| 假设 | 排除依据 |
239	|------|---------|
240	| verify_tree / retrive_index bug | 验证逻辑正确，ridx=[0..7] 全列出 |

243	| 32K 词表覆盖不足 | OOD 覆盖率 97%，不在词表的位置已 mask |
244	
245	## 11. 下一步
246	
247	1. **端到端测速**：用现有 epoch_4 sglang_model 跑 mini_bench，确认 EAGLE-3 vs Medusa 的实际速度差异

```
1	# Empty Response Investigation Handover
2	
3	Date: 2026-04-13
4	
5	> **RESOLVED (2026-04-13)**: 空响应问题已通过升级 FlashInfer 至 0.6.7.post3 + cuDNN 至 9.20 修复。根因是旧版 FlashInfer (0.5.3) 的 CUTLASS FP4 GEMM 在 SM120 上产生 NaN。平台验证 no-spec 和 spec_medusa_k1 均零空响应，ori_accuracy=79.11%。
6	
7	## Goal
8	
9	This document is the handover for the long-running investigation into the "empty response" problem seen on the evaluation platform for MiniCPM-SALA / SOAR submissions.
10	
11	This document is intentionally written as a working log, not as a polished postmortem.
12	
13	## Short Current Conclusion
14	
15	As of this handover:
16	
17	- the empty-response problem is **not explained by Medusa alone**
18	- the problem is **not explained by missing FlashInfer GDC flags alone**
19	- the problem is **not explained by failing to replace `common_ops.abi3.so` alone**
20	- the problem still reproduces on platform in **no-spec** mode
21	- platform and local image/config are believed to be the same; the remaining gap is more likely runtime behavior than static config drift
22	- upgrading `flashinfer-python` and `flashinfer-cubin` to `0.6.7.post3` does **not immediately break** `minicpm_flashinfer` imports
23	- but `flashinfer.mm_fp4(..., backend="cudnn")` is still **not usable** on this machine because cuDNN cannot create an execution plan for tested NVFP4 GEMM shapes
24	
25	## Working Goal Evolution
26	
27	The investigation moved through several stages:
28	
29	1. Initial suspicion:
30	   platform-specific empty responses were caused by mismatched `.so` files or missing environment setup.
31	2. Second suspicion:
32	   FlashInfer SM120 FP4 CUTLASS JIT on platform was still using the old recipe without GDC flags.
33	3. Probe evidence corrected that:
34	   on current evaluation machines, `core.py` already had the GDC flag before our patch.
35	4. Third suspicion:
36	   Medusa/speculative decode was the main source.
37	5. No-spec probe corrected that:
38	   empty responses still existed with spec fully disabled.
39	6. Current working direction:
40	   investigate deeper FP4 runtime path and test whether cuDNN FP4 GEMM can replace CUTLASS for this stack.
41	
42	## Important Corrections to Earlier Thinking
43	
44	Several earlier claims were too strong and were corrected by evidence.
45	
46	### 1. "Missing GDC flag is the user_4813494d cause"
47	
48	This was plausible historically, but current platform probe evidence does not support it as the full explanation anymore.
49	
50	Platform evidence showed:
51	
52	- `flashinfer/jit/gemm/core.py` already had `CUTLASS_ENABLE_GDC_FOR_SM100=1`
53	- the md5 before and after patch was identical
54	- there was no pre-existing bad JIT cache in that run
55	
56	So on current platform machines, the GDC patch is not the main varying factor.
57	
58	### 2. "Spec/Medusa is the main source"
59	
60	This is not sufficient either.
61	
62	The no-spec full probe still produced empty responses, so Medusa can amplify the issue, but does not fully explain it.
63	
64	### 3. "`finish_reason == length` means not a real empty-response bug"
65	
66	This was also corrected.
67	
68	In this codebase, `finish_reason == "length"` means:
69	
70	- generation hit `max_new_tokens`
71	
72	It does **not** mean the prompt context filled the model context window.
73	
74	If a sample has:
75	
76	- `finish_reason = "length"`
77	- `completion_tokens = 500`
78	- `prediction = ""`
79	
80	then the model generated 500 output tokens but they all ended up as non-visible output after detokenization / filtering. This is still an abnormal result and should still be treated as an empty-response symptom.
81	
82	## Key Probe Artifacts
83	
84	### Quick spec probe
85	
86	Artifact:
87	
88	- `/user_4813494d/predictions.jsonl (1).gz`
89	
90	Observed empty outputs:
91	
92	- `72 qa length 500`
93	- `73 qa length 500`
94	- `85 qa length 500`
95	- `87 qa length 500`
96	
97	Count:
98	
99	- 4 empty responses
100
```

90	# 评测环境
91	为便于参赛选手有针对性地开展优化工作，现对评测环境说明如下：
92	- 参赛选手提交的全部文件总大小不得超过 2GB。
93	- 单次评测任务的资源上限为：20 CPU、128 GiB 内存。
94	- 单次评测任务的最长执行时间为 5 小时（不包含排队等待时间）。
95	- 硬件环境：本次比赛统一采用 NVIDIA 高端 RTX PRO 单卡 GPU 进行评测。
96	
97	# 模型正确性评测
98	为了验证选手们对推理代码的优化不会影响模型在正确性上的表现，我们通过测试模型在特定数据集上的得分来进行评估。这里我们公开评测正确性所用的数据集`perf_public_set.jsonl`以及用于评测正确性的脚本`eval_model.py`，选手们也可以通过该数据集进行自查。
99	
100	## perf_public_set.jsonl
101	下载地址：https://github.com/OpenBMB/SOAR-Toolkit/blob/main/eval_dataset/perf_public_set.jsonl
102	
103	本数据集包含不同长度的选择题或者信息提取题目，能够综合测试模型的整体性能表现。MiniCPM-SALA 在该数据集上的得分约在 82±2 分，我们取 80 分作为基准分。在对选手提交的代码进行评估的过程中，我们会验证模型在本数据集上的得分相对于基准分的相对分数，以此来判断模型能力在修改过程中是否会有所下降。该文件包含以下字段：
104	- `task`：任务类型
105	- `question`：输入 prompt 文本
106	- `gold`：参考答案/关键词列表等（不同任务类型含义不同）
107	
108	示例：
109	```json
110	{"question":"...题目文本...", "task":"mcq", "gold":"B"}
111	```
112	> 为避免可能存在的刷分行为，我们会在内部准备一个私有集`perf_private_set.jsonl`。两个数据集的长度分布和任务一致，在原始模型推理结果中分数相近，主要用于检查模型是否会在两个数据集上存在较大的差距，保证比赛的公平性。

114	## eval_model.py
115	下载地址：https://github.com/OpenBMB/SOAR-Toolkit/blob/main/eval_model.py

117	`eval_model.py` 会通过调用已启动的 SGLang 推理服务，根据不同评测任务类型，给出模型在正确性上的评测分数，最后得到的`ori_accuracy`表示模型在该数据集上的原始得分，得到`overall_accuracy`表示相对于上述基准分（80 分）的分数，判断推理代码是否会影响模型的正确性效果。首先需要启动 SGLang 服务，并传入模型所使用的api_base：

125	```

127	- `--api_base`：SGLang 服务地址
128	- `--model_path`：模型路径
129	- `--data_path`：数据集路径
130	- `--concurrency`：（optional）并发请求数
131	- `--num_samples`：（optional）最多评测样本数（调试时可以进行少样本测试）
132	- `--verbose`：（optional）打印每条样本更详细的信息

```
# Repository Guidelines

## 1. 仓库定位

这个仓库不是单一应用，而是一个围绕 SOAR / MiniCPM-SALA 推理优化比赛组织起来的工作区。当前至少有三条活跃主线：

- `demo-sala/`：正式提交包。平台真正消费的是这条线。
- `probe-sala/`：带埋点和邮件回传的 probe 提交包，用来定位“平台上复现、本地不复现”的问题。
- 仓库根目录下的 `eval/`、`bench/`、`medusa/`、`eagle/`、`quant/`、`kernels/`：本地实验、性能验证、精度排查、草稿模型训练和 CUDA 内核研究区。

如果你要改线上提交行为，优先看 `demo-sala/`。  
如果你要排查平台特有问题，优先看 `probe-sala/`、`probe-env-diff/`、`probe-so-test/` 和根目录 `HANDOVER.md`。  
如果你要复现实验结论、排查精度或性能回退，优先看 `eval/`、`bench/`、`medusa/`、`eagle/`、`quant/`。

## 2. 当前真实主线状态

不要把这个仓库当成“最小 demo”或“官方 toolkit 镜像副本”。当前工作树已经是一套带本地补丁、硬编码路径和多条实验分支的实战工作区。

### 2.1 `demo-sala/` 提交路径

基于当前工作树，默认提交方案已经不是 README 里写的简单 copy demo，而是：

- `demo-sala/prepare_env.sh`
  - 用 `uv pip install --no-deps -e demo-sala/sglang/python` 安装自定义 SGLang。
  - 安装 `nvidia-modelopt==0.42.0` 和 `llmcompressor==[REDACTED]`。
  - 用 `demo-sala/patches/gptq_quantize_fouroversix.py` 覆盖 llmcompressor 的 GPTQ 逻辑，启用 FourOverSix。
  - 替换站内 `sgl_kernel/sm100/common_ops.abi3.so`。
  - 默认导出 `modelopt_fp4 + dense-as-sparse + Medusa(spec=1)` 的 `SGLANG_SERVER_ARGS`。
  - 默认导出 `SGLANG_MARLIN_DECODE_THRESHOLD=36`、`SGLANG_MEDUSA_BS_THRESHOLD=16`。
- `demo-sala/prepare_model.sh` / `demo-sala/preprocess_model.py`
  - 当前量化路径是 GPTQ + NVFP4 + FourOverSix。
  - 当前校准集不是旧版 `calib_wikitext_24k_150.jsonl`，而是 `demo-sala/data/calib_wikitext_loguniform_128.jsonl`。
  - 当前量化配置是 `48K` 上下文、`128` 个 log-uniform wikitext 样本、shuffle、seed=42。
  - 导出后会把 llmcompressor 格式改写成 SGLang `modelopt_fp4` 可直接消费的格式，并恢复 `sparse_config` / `max_position_embeddings` / `lm_head`。

### 2.2 `probe-sala/` 平台问题定位路径

`probe-sala/` 基本复制了 `demo-sala/` 的提交路径，但增加了：

- `probe_eval.py`：本地拉起 server、跑整套公开集、收集 predictions/summary、邮件回传。
- `probe_email.py`：在量化前后回传环境和日志。
- `prepare_model.sh` 末尾故意 `exit 1`，这是 probe 设计的一部分，不是 bug。

这条线不是常规提交包，而是平台差异定位工具。不要把 `probe-sala/prepare_model.sh` 的行为误改回“正常返回 0”。

### 2.3 `eagle/` 已经不是纯计划文档

`eagle/` 里已经有完整的：

- `collect_data.py`：从带 hook 的 target server 采集中间层 hidden 和 top-k logits。
- `train.py`：训练 EAGLE-3 draft。
- `convert_to_sglang.py`：把训练 ckpt 转成 `eagle/sglang_model/`。
- `weights/`、`sglang_model/`：已有训练产物和可加载草稿模型目录。

也就是说，EAGLE-3 在这个仓库里已经进入“可训练、可转换、可接 SGLang”的阶段，不只是文档计划。

## 3. 目录职责

- `demo-sala/`
  - 比赛正式提交入口。
  - 关键文件：`prepare_env.sh`、`prepare_model.sh`、`preprocess_model.py`、`patches/`、`data/`、`sglang/python/`。
- `probe-sala/`
  - 平台复现 / 邮件回传 / 空响应排查用提交包。
  - 关键文件：`prepare_env.sh`、`prepare_model.sh`、`probe_eval.py`、`probe_email.py`。
- `probe-env-diff/`
  - 最小环境差异 probe，只关注平台环境、包版本和 `.so` md5。
- `probe-so-test/`
  - 最小 `.so` 替换验证包，只验证平台侧 `common_ops.abi3.so` 是否真的被替换。
- `eval/`
  - 本地启动 server、跑公开集、做 failed case probe、实时观察增量结果。
  - 关键脚本：`start_public_eval_server.sh`、`start_spec.sh`、`run_public_eval_full.py`、`watch_public_eval_live.py`。
- `bench/`
  - 速度基准与 server 生命周期管理。
  - 关键脚本：`mini_bench.sh`、`kill_sglang.sh`、`trigger_profile.sh`。
- `medusa/`
  - Medusa speculative decoding 数据采集、训练、评估和权重。
  - 当前默认线上 spec 仍是 Medusa K=1。
- `eagle/`
```

1	# Four Over Six (4/6) NVFP4 Integration
2	
3	## What is it
4	
5	Four Over Six (MIT-HAN Lab, arXiv: 2512.02010) improves NVFP4 quantization accuracy by using
6	adaptive block scaling: instead of fixing all block scales to `scale=6` (standard NVFP4), it
7	selects `scale=4` or `scale=6` per block based on MSE comparison. The output is still 4-bit
8	NVFP4 weights + FP8 block scales — same format, better accuracy.
9	
10	**Expected gain**: +0.5–2% accuracy vs standard NVFP4, zero throughput impact at serving time.
11	
12	Papers: arXiv 2512.02010, arXiv 2603.28765
13	Reference implementation: `/user_4813494d/fouroversix`
14	
15	---
16	
17	## Implementation approach
18	
19	We integrated FourOverSix directly into llmcompressor's GPTQ pipeline, rather than using
20	fouroversix's standalone quantization library. This preserves our existing calibration flow
21	(awq_lite + GPTQ), and places scale selection **before** the GPTQ Hessian compensation loop,
22	so GPTQ optimizes rounding for the correct quantization grid.
23	
24	**Key insight**: FourOverSix's core idea is simple — for each group of weights, compare
25	reconstruction error between `scale=6` (standard) and `scale=4` (tighter range, higher
26	precision in [-4,4]). The scale selection is independent of GPTQ, so it can be inserted
27	as a single function call between observer output and the GPTQ optimization loop.
28	
29	### How it works
30	
31	NVFP4 uses two-level scaling:
32	- **Per-block scale** (FP8): `weight_scale = fp8(global_scale × amax_block / 6.0)`
33	- **Per-tensor scale** (FP32): `weight_scale_2 = amax_tensor / 2688`
34	
35	Standard NVFP4 always divides by 6.0 (the FP4 E2M1 max), mapping weights to [-6, 6].
36	FourOverSix tries dividing by 4.0 instead (achieved by multiplying the FP8 scale by 1.5),
37	mapping weights to [-4, 4] — using only 7 of 8 representable FP4 levels but with finer
38	granularity. Per block, whichever scale gives lower MSE wins.
39	
40	### Modified files
41	
42	**`/user_4813494d/llm-compressor/src/llmcompressor/modifiers/quantization/gptq/gptq_quantize.py`**
43	(branch `fouroversix`, based on tag [REDACTED])
44	
45	Added:
46	1. `FOUROVERSIX_ENABLED = os.environ.get("FOUROVERSIX", "1") == "1"` — env toggle
47	2. `_fouroversix_scale_select(W, scale, quant_args, global_scale)` — core function (~40 lines)
48	3. Insertion point after observer returns scale, before GPTQ loop:
49	```python
50	if (
51	    FOUROVERSIX_ENABLED
52	    and quant_args.num_bits == 4
53	    and quant_args.type == QuantizationType.FLOAT
54	    and global_scale is not None
55	    and strategy in (QuantizationStrategy.GROUP, QuantizationStrategy.TENSOR_GROUP)
56	):
57	    scale = _fouroversix_scale_select(W, scale, quant_args, global_scale)
58	```
59	
60	### `_fouroversix_scale_select` algorithm
61	
62	```
63	Input: W [rows, cols], scale [rows, groups] (FP8), quant_args, global_scale
64	1. Reshape W into groups: W_groups [rows, num_groups, group_size]
65	2. scale_6 = scale (standard, already from observer)
66	3. scale_4 = fp8(scale_6.float() * 1.5)   # scale=4 alternative
67	4. eff_6 = scale_6 / global_scale          # effective per-group scale
68	5. eff_4 = scale_4 / global_scale
69	6. For each candidate scale:
70	   a. Scale weights: scaled = W_groups / eff.unsqueeze(-1)
71	   b. Quantize: q = FP4_E2M1_DATA.cast_to_fp4(scaled.clamp(-6, 6))
72	   c. Dequantize: deq = q * eff.unsqueeze(-1)
73	   d. mse = sum((W_groups - deq)^2, dim=-1)
74	7. Per-group selection: use_4 = (mse_4 < mse_6)
75	8. new_scale = where(use_4, scale_4, scale_6)   # done in float32, cast back to FP8
76	Output: new_scale [rows, groups] (FP8)
77	```
78	
79	### Submission packaging
80	
81	The modified `gptq_quantize.py` is copied to `demo-sala/patches/gptq_quantize_fouroversix.py`.
82	At submission time, `prepare_env.sh` patches the installed llmcompressor:
83	
84	```bash
85	GPTQ_TARGET="...site-packages/llmcompressor/modifiers/quantization/gptq/gptq_quantize.py"
86	cp "${SCRIPT_DIR}/patches/gptq_quantize_fouroversix.py" "$GPTQ_TARGET"
87	```
88	
89	No serving code changes needed — output format is standard NVFP4.
90	
91	---
92	
93	## Why this approach vs standalone fouroversix
94	
95	| Approach | Pros | Cons |
96	|----------|------|------|
97	| **llmcompressor patch** (chosen) | Reuses existing calibration/GPTQ pipeline, GPTQ Hessian compensates for selected scale, minimal code change (~50 lines), no new dependencies | Only MSE heuristic (no MAE option) |
98	| **fouroversix library** (original plan) | Full feature set, CUDA kernels for speed | New quantization script, tensor name mapping, block scale layout verification, heavy dependency |
99	
100	The llmcompressor patch achieves the core 4/6 benefit (adaptive scale selection with MSE)
101	with minimal risk and zero throughput impact.
102	
103	---
104	
105	## Observed behavior
106	
107	Layer 0 quantization logs (MiniCPM-SALA):
108	- **40–43% of blocks selected scale=4** (varies by projection type)
109	- MLP layers (gate/up/down_proj): largest MSE reduction (22–38 per layer)
110	- Attention layers (q/k/v/o_proj): smaller MSE reduction (0.1–8.4)
111	- All MSE reductions positive (no regressions from scale selection)
112	
113	This aligns with the paper's findings: MLP weights have broader distributions that
114	benefit more from adaptive scaling.
115

123	- [x] Deterministic quantization seeds (`torch.manual_seed(42)`, `shuffle_calibration_samples=False`)

```
Data budget:

Prerequisites:
```

## 调查总结：训练数据实际 token 分布

### 关键发现

**按 token 计，代码实际占比：42.0%**（与按样本数的占比相同）

详细分布：
- **Code**: 4,200 samples × 2048 tokens = **8.6M tokens (42.0%)**
- **SkyPile**: 5,000 samples × 2048 tokens = **10.2M tokens (50.0%)**
- **Wikitext**: 800 samples × 2048 tokens = **1.6M tokens (8.0%)**
- **总计**: 10,000 samples × 2048 tokens = **20.48M tokens**

### 代码采样逻辑分析

代码中的采样方式非常统一：

1. **三个数据源都使用完全相同的截断策略**
   - 所有样本都被逐样本地编码成 token ID
   - 使用滑动窗口缓冲区，每次截取**恰好 2048 tokens** (`chunk = buf_ids[:SEQ_LEN]`)
   - 第 82 行：`SEQ_LEN = 2048` 硬编码

2. **代码没有特殊处理**
   - Code 采样（code_search_net）采用**相同的 2048-token 截断**
   - 不存在代码样本更长的情况（都在 2048 limit 内）
   - 代码按语言分配比例（Python 60%、Java 16%、Go 12% 等），但最终仍受 2048 token 限制

3. **采样方式特点**
   - 虽然代码函数平均字符长度更长（6000+ chars vs 3000+ chars），但这些都会被一视同仁地截断到 2048 tokens
   - 使用 `tokenizer.decode()` 确保 token 到文本的映射准确

### 数据统计验证

从 `/user_4813494d/openbmb/eagle/data/manifest.json` 验证：
- manifest 中记录的 10,000 个样本与 code 中的 BUDGET 定义完全匹配
- 代码语言分布：Python 2498 (59.5% of code)、Java 672、Go 499、JavaScript 347 等

### 结论

**您的假设不成立**。虽然代码样本的原始文本确实更长，但由于 SEQ_LEN=2048 的硬截断，token 分布与样本分布完全相同：

| 数据源 | 按样本数 | 按 token 数 | 变化 |
|--------|---------|-----------|------|
| SkyPile | 50.0% | 50.0% | — |
| Code | 42.0% | 42.0% | — |
| Wikitext | 8.0% | 8.0% | — |

代码在设计上**确保了公平性** —— 不管原始文本多长，每个样本最后都贡献恰好 2048 tokens。

```
        causal_mask: (1, 1, S, S)

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.down_proj(F.silu(self.gate_proj(x)) * self.up_proj(x))


# ── Decoder Layer ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
class Eagle3DecoderLayer(nn.Module):
--
    def forward(self, input_emb, hidden_states, cache_k_list=None, cache_v_list=None, causal_mask=None):
        """
        input_emb: (B, S, H) - embedded tokens
        hidden_states: (B, S, H) - running hidden from fc or prior step
        cache_k_list, cache_v_list: list of tensors from prior TTT steps
        Returns: new_hidden (B, S, H), cache_k_list, cache_v_list
--
    def forward(self, token_ids, aux_hidden, target_logits_values, target_logits_indices):
        """
        EAGLE-3 training with shifted alignment to match inference.

        Inference pattern: (embed(x_{t+1}), fc(aux[t])) → predict x_{t+2}
        So we shift inputs: position t gets token[t+1] with hidden[t], target[t+1].
```

## 调查结论：NVFP4 原生训练对 EAGLE-3 Draft Head 的含义

基于代码库的详细调查，我理解了用户提到的"原生进行NVFP4训练 参考oss120b"在 EAGLE-3 draft head 训练上下文中的具体含义。

### 当前状态（BF16 精度）

**Eagle 训练流程（`/user_4813494d/openbmb/eagle/train.py`）**：
- Draft model 以 **BF16** 精度训练（第62行：`DTYPE = torch.bfloat16`）
- 模型架构：fc(12288→4096) + 完整 decoder layer + norm + lm_head（437M 参数）
- 训练数据来自 **NVFP4 量化后的 target 模型**：
  ```python
  MODEL_PATH = [REDACTED]
  ```
- 数据格式：采集 target 模型的 layer 1, 10, 22 的 MLP delta 输出 + top-256 logits（来自已量化的 target）
- **关键点**：draft 模型本身不做量化，始终 BF16，但学习的是来自 FP4 量化 target 模型的分布

### "原生进行NVFP4训练"在 OSS 120B 上的参考含义

通过搜索代码库中关于 gpt-oss-120b 的引用：

**在 SGLang 推理部分的注释**（`eagle_worker.py`）：
```python
# but some models (e.g. nvidia/gpt-oss-120b-Eagle3) shares
# [lm_head from target]
```

这说明 **OSS 120B 是一个已有 EAGLE-3 draft model 的参考模型**，且该 draft model 在某些情况下与 target model 共享 lm_head。

### 如果 Draft Model "原生进行NVFP4训练"需要的具体改动

如果要让 EAGLE-3 draft model 在 **NVFP4 精度下原生训练**（类似大模型的量化训练），技术上需要：

#### 1. **架构层面改动** - 量化感知训练 (QAT)

**在 `eagle/train.py` 中修改**：

a) **导入量化库**：
```python
from sglang.srt.layers.quantization.base_config import QuantizationConfig
from llmcompressor.modifiers.quantization import GPTQModifier
```

b) **模型初始化时应用量化配置**：
```python
quant_config = QuantizationConfig(scheme="NVFP4", ...)
model = Eagle3Model(embed_weight, lm_head_weight, quant_config=quant_config)
```

c) **线性层替换为量化线性层**：
```python
# 当前：
self.fc = nn.Linear(AUX_DIM, HIDDEN_SIZE, bias=False)

# 改为：
from sglang.srt.layers.linear import QuantizableLinear
self.fc = QuantizableLinear(AUX_DIM, HIDDEN_SIZE, quant_config=quant_config)
```

#### 2. **权重初始化策略**

a) **权重初始化从目标模型的量化版本**：
```python
# 当前加载 BF16 权重：
with safe_open(...) as f:
    embed_weight = f.get_tensor("model.embed_tokens.weight").float()
    lm_weight = f.get_tensor("lm_head.weight").float()

# FP4 原生训练应该：
# 1. 加载 FP4 权重（解包）
# 2. 初始化为伪量化权重（dequant → 模拟量化）
# 3. 在训练中保持量化约束
```

#### 3. **训练流程修改**

a) **前向传播中应用伪量化**：
```python
# 在 forward() 中每次前向时应用量化约束
hidden = self.fc(aux_shifted)  # → 添加量化感知

# 类似于：
if self.quant_config is not None:
    hidden = apply_fake_quantization(hidden, self.quant_config)
```

b) **梯度更新策略**：
- 权重梯度计算后，在量化空间内进行更新（而非完整 FP32）
- 确保权重始终在量化网格内

#### 4. **loss 和精度监控**

```python
# 添加量化误差项到 loss（可选）
quant_loss = compute_quantization_loss(model)
total_loss = ce_loss + alpha * quant_loss

# 在评估中监控：
- 伪量化精度 (FP4 模型的 valid position accuracy)
- 与完整精度 baseline 的 gap
```

#### 5. **具体参考实现**

代码库中已有类似框架的参考：

- **Llama Eagle3 量化支持**（`/user_4813494d/openbmb/demo-sala/sglang/python/sglang/srt/models/llama_eagle3.py`）：
  ```python
  class LlamaModel(nn.Module):
      def __init__(self, config, quant_config=None, ...):
          self.fc = torch.nn.Linear(...)  # 需改为可量化层
          self.midlayer = LlamaDecoderLayer(config, 0, quant_config, ...)
  ```

- **GPTQ + NVFP4 量化流程参考**（`/user_4813494d/openbmb/quant/gptq_nvfp4.py`）：
  - 使用 llmcompressor 的 GPTQModifier
  - scheme="NVFP4" 配置
  - 可作为后量化的基础

### 核心差异对比

| 方面 | 当前 (BF16) | NVFP4 原生训练 |
|------|-----------|--------------|
| **模型精度** | BF16 全精度 | FP4 伪量化 |
| **权重形式** | 完整 FP32/BF16 | 量化网格约束 + FP8 scale |
| **学习的分布** | BF16 target logits | NVFP4 量化 target logits |
| **内存占用** | ~1.4 GB (safetensors) | ~0.35-0.4 GB (压缩 4 倍) |
| **训练时间** | 基线 | 可能 +5-15% (量化开销) |
| **推理速度** | 标准 BF16 (1×) | NVFP4 加速 (如果使用 Marlin 内核) |
| **量化误差** | N/A | 可控（通过 QAT） |

### OSS 120B 的启示

OSS 120B 上的 EAGLE-3 draft model（如果原生 FP4 训练）能够：
1. **减少显存占用**：从 1.4 GB → ~350-400 MB
2. **加速推理**：利用 NVFP4 量化内核（Marlin/CUTLASS）
3. **保持精度**：通过量化感知训练补偿量化引入的误差

**现有 epoch_4 checkpoint 的迁移策略**：
- 可以将现有 BF16 checkpoint 后量化为 FP4（更简单但精度可能下降 1-3%）
- 或从头用 FP4 原生训练（更复杂但精度更高）

根据我对SOAR竞赛评测工具和评分标准的全面调查，以下是详细报告：

## SOAR竞赛评测指标和验收标准完整调查报告

### 一、核心评分指标体系

SOAR竞赛的评分包含**两个独立且并行的主要指标**：

#### 1. 正确性评测（Correctness Evaluation）
**文件位置**：`/user_4813494d/openbmb/toolkit/eval_model.py`

**输出指标**：
- `ori_accuracy`：模型在perf_public_set.jsonl数据集上的原始得分（百分比，0-100）
- `overall_accuracy`：相对于基准分80分的归一化得分，计算公式为：
  ```
  overall_accuracy = min(round(ori_accuracy / 80 * 100, 2), 100)
  ```

**评测数据集**：
- 公开集：`perf_public_set.jsonl`（约50-100样本，包含不同长度的选择题MCQ和信息提取任务）
- 私有集：`perf_private_set.jsonl`（内部保留，长度分布和任务类型与公开集一致，用于防止过拟合）

**基准分设定**：
- MiniCPM-SALA在该数据集上的原始得分约为82±2分
- 官方取**80分作为基准分**（从toolkit/README.md第103行）

**任务类型及计分方式**：
```python
- mcq（多选题）：精确匹配，提取ANSWER: X / \boxed{X}格式，得分0或1
- qa/niah/lcx（问答/长文本）：包含匹配，gold列表中任意一个候选答案即为完全正确，得分0或1
- cwe/fwe（实体提取）：覆盖率计分，需提取所有gold中的关键词，得分为hits/len(gold)
```

#### 2. 速度评测（Speed Evaluation）
**文件位置**：`/user_4813494d/openbmb/toolkit/bench_serving.sh`

**输出指标**：
- `Benchmark Duration (s)`：完整测试耗时（秒）
  
**测试结构**（3档并发度）：
```
S1:  并发度=1
S8:  并发度=8  
Smax: 无并发上限
```

**测试方式**：
- 使用sglang官方`bench_serving`工具
- 通过**固定的模型输入和输出**来测试速度（不是真实生成）
- 测试数据集格式：
  ```json
  {"question": "问题内容...", "model_response": "模型回答内容..."}
  ```
- 将输入/输出转换成conversations格式后，由bench_serving进行并发请求测试

**具体指标**：
- Benchmark Duration统计的是**完整测试周期耗时**（秒）
- 从输出中提取`Benchmark duration (s):`之后的数值

---

### 二、关键发现：评分标准的真实情况

#### 用户质疑的澄清：

**问题1：E2E提升是接受优化的唯一指标？**
**答案**：**否**。官方同时关注两个指标：
- `ori_accuracy / overall_accuracy`（正确性，权重未显式说明）
- `Benchmark Duration`（速度）

**问题2：ori_accuracy的门槛77.6/80是硬性的还是加权的？**
**答案**：
- 基准分是**80分**（不是77.6或80.6）
- 这是**相对评估的参考基准**，不是硬性门槛
- 官方文档说"判断模型能力在修改过程中**是否会有所下降**"（toolkit/README.md 第103、117行）
- 加权方式是：`overall_accuracy = min(ori_accuracy / 80 * 100, 2), 100)`
  - 若ori_accuracy=80，则overall_accuracy=100%
  - 若ori_accuracy=76，则overall_accuracy=95%（允许掉点）
  - 上限封顶在100%（即使ori_accuracy超过80也不额外加分）

**问题3：速度测试的具体指标是什么？**
**答案**：
- **唯一输出的速度指标是：`Benchmark Duration (s)`**（总耗时，秒）
- 这是"3档并发度下完整跑完所有评测请求的总时间"
- bench_serving工具不直接输出吞吐量(tokens/s)或延迟(TTFT)，只输出总耗时
- mini_bench.sh中还会计算平均prompt_tokens（用于分层抽样），但不是最终得分指标

**问题4：有没有penalty机制（比如空响应扣分）？**
**答案**：
- **空响应问题已修复**（docs/empty-response-investigation-handover-20260413.md，2026-04-13）
  - 根因：旧版FlashInfer (0.5.3) 的CUTLASS FP4 GEMM在SM120上产生NaN
  - 修复：升级FlashInfer至0.6.7.post3 + cuDNN至9.20
  - 平台验证结果：no-spec和spec_medusa_k1均零空响应，ori_accuracy=79.11%

- **在eval_model.py中的计分逻辑**：
  ```python
  outputs[idx] = content if content is not None else ""  # 空响应记为空字符串
  # 后续score_mcq / score_exact_match 中，空字符串得分为0
  ```
  - 空响应会导致该样本得0分（无额外penalty）
  - 整体accuracy = (正确样本数) / (总样本数)

- **没有发现其他penalty机制**（如答案过短、超时等会额外扣分）

---

### 三、最终评分整合方式

基于代码分析和文档审查，**官方未在公开文档中明确说明最终排名/得分的权重公式**。

**已知的评测流程**：
1. 正确性评测：得到`ori_accuracy`和`overall_accuracy`
2. 速度评测（3档）：得到S1/S8/Smax的`Benchmark Duration`
3. **综合方式**：
   - toolkit/README_EN.md第85行明确说"The final score is subject to the official evaluation environment"
   - eval/run_public_eval_full.py和toolkit/eval_model.py都输出两个独立的指标对象，未见明确的权重组合
   - AGENTS.md第一条建议："启服务后跑公开集 accuracy，必要时再补 speed bench"，暗示accuracy是首要指标

**推理的评分权重模式**：
- 竞赛官方很可能采用**两步式评分**：
  1. **门槛验证**：ori_accuracy≥某阈值（可能75-80分之间）合格
  2. **速度排名**：在合格的提交中，按Benchmark Duration从低到高排名
  - 但未在公开文档中明确此阈值

---

### 四、具体评测指标汇总表

| 指标 | 源文件 | 计算方式 | 输出格式 | 权重/用途 |
|------|--------|---------|---------|----------|
| ori_accuracy | eval_model.py:L432 | (正确样本数/总样本数)×100 | 浮点百分比(0-100) | 正确性评估，与80分基准比较 |
| overall_accuracy | eval_model.py:L433 | min(ori_accuracy/80×100, 100) | 浮点百分比(0-100) | 相对基准得分，上限100% |
| Benchmark Duration (S1) | bench_serving.sh:L162 | 并发度=1时的总耗时 | 浮点秒数 | 低并发场景速度 |
| Benchmark Duration (S8) | bench_serving.sh:L162 | 并发度=8时的总耗时 | 浮点秒数 | 中等并发场景速度 |
| Benchmark Duration (Smax) | bench_serving.sh:L162 | 无并发限制时的总耗时 | 浮点秒数 | 高并发场景速度 |

---

### 五、验收标准判断

**模型能力下降判断**（toolkit/README.md第103-117行）：
- 通过ori_accuracy与80分基准的相对值来判断
- 如ori_accuracy从原始82分降至70分，则overall_accuracy=87.5%，被判定为有掉点

**评测合格性**：
- 没有看到明确的"必须≥77.6分"的硬性要求
- 官方通过公开集和私有集的分布一致性来防止过优化

---

### 六、结论

**用户的质疑"E2E提升是接受优化的唯一指标"是错误的**。SOAR竞赛官方明确区分了：
1. **正确性指标**（ori_accuracy / overall_accuracy）——必须保证模型能力不显著下降
2. **速度指标**（Benchmark Duration S1/S8/Smax）——优化的目标

这两个指标都被官方评测系统记录和输出，但最终排名权重公式在公开文档中**未明确揭示**。基于评测工具的优先级和AGENTS.md的建议，合理推断是：**先验证accuracy合格性，再按speed排名**。

```
2	"""

4	
5	Data budget v2: ~40M tokens/epoch, 3 epochs
6	  - Chinese 50%: SkyPile-150B (short 4K + long 16K)
7	  - Code 40%: code_search_net multi-language (Python/Java/Go/JS/PHP+Ruby)
8	  - English 10%: wikitext-103 (short 4K + long 16K)
9	  - val_ood: bench model_response chunks (unchanged from v1)

13	  - Uses concatenated code_search_net functions to fill 4K chunks properly

15	The _maybe_collect_hidden hook in minicpm.py splits long sequences into

103	def _chunk_ids(token_ids, tokenizer, chunk_len):
104	    """Chunk token list into pieces, return decoded texts."""
105	    chunks = []

109	            continue

315	
316	async def send_request(session, text, api_base, sem):
317	    payload = {"model": "default", "prompt": text, "max_tokens": 1, "temperature": 0}
318	    async with sem:
319	        try:
320	            async with session.post(
321	                f"{api_base}/v1/completions",
322	                json=payload,
323	                timeout=aiohttp.ClientTimeout(total=600),
324	            ) as resp:
325	                await resp.json()
326	                return True
327	        except Exception as e:
328	            print(f"\n  Error: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
329	            return False
330	
331	
332	async def collect_split(session, samples, split_name, api_base, sem, output_dir):
333	    split_dir = output_dir / split_name
334	    split_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
335	
336	    # Clean stale files from collect dir
337	    for f in COLLECT_DIR.glob("*.pt"):
338	        f.unlink()
339	
340	    success, fail = 0, 0
341	    pbar = tqdm(total=len(samples), desc=f"  {split_name}", unit="seq")
342	
343	    tasks = []
344	    for sample in samples:
345	        task = asyncio.create_task(send_request(session, sample["text"], api_base, sem))
346	        tasks.append(task)
347	
348	    for task in asyncio.as_completed(tasks):
349	        ok = await task
350	        if ok:
351	            success += 1
352	        else:
353	            fail += 1
354	        pbar.update(1)
355	        pbar.set_postfix(ok=success, fail=fail)
356	    pbar.close()
357	
358	    await asyncio.sleep(2)
359	
360	    pt_files = sorted(COLLECT_DIR.glob("*.pt"))
361	    for f in pt_files:
362	        shutil.move(str(f), str(split_dir / f.name))
363	
364	    total_bytes = sum(f.stat().st_size for f in split_dir.glob("*.pt"))
365	    print(f"    → {len(pt_files)} files, {total_bytes / 1024**3:.2f} GB")
366	    return len(pt_files)
367	
368	
369	async def collect_all(splits, api_base, concurrency, output_dir):
370	    COLLECT_DIR.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
371	    sem = asyncio.Semaphore(concurrency)
372	
373	    async with aiohttp.ClientSession() as session:
374	        # Health check via /v1/models (not /health per project convention)
375	        try:
376	            async with session.get(f"{api_base}/v1/models") as resp:
377	                if resp.status != 200:
378	                    print(f"Server not ready: {resp.status}")
379	                    return
380	        except Exception as e:
381	            print(f"Cannot reach server: {e}")
382	            return
383	
384	        total = 0
385	        for split_name in ["train", "val", "val_ood"]:
386	            samples = splits.get(split_name)
387	            if not samples:
388	                continue
389	            n = await collect_split(session, samples, split_name, api_base, sem, output_dir)
390	            total += n
391	
392	    meta = {
393	        "total_files": total,
394	        "splits": {name: len(s) for name, s in splits.items()},
395	        "timestamp": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
396	        "config": {
397	            "short_len": SHORT_LEN, "long_len": LONG_LEN,
398	            "budget": "v2_40M", "code_languages": list(CODE_LANG_PCT.keys()),
399	        },
400	    }
401	    with open(output_dir / "meta.json", "w") as f:
402	        json.dump(meta, f, indent=2)
403	    print(f"\nDone! {total} files → {output_dir}/")
404	
405	
406	def main():
407	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
408	    parser.add_argument("--api-base", default="http://127.0.0.1:30000")
409	    parser.add_argument("--output", default="medusa/data")
410	    parser.add_argument("--concurrency", type=int, default=64)
411	    parser.add_argument("--train-only", action="store_true",
412	                        help="Only regenerate train split (keep existing val/val_ood)")
413	    parser.add_argument("--code-supplement", action="store_true",
414	                        help="Only collect additional code data to supplement existing train")
415	    args = parser.parse_args()
416	
417	    os.chdir(REPO_user_4813494d)
418	    output_dir = Path(args.output)
419	
420	    print("Loading tokenizer...")
421	    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(MODEL_PATH, trust_remote_code=True)
422	
423	    if args.code_supplement:
424	        print("Preparing code supplement (v3)...")
425	        splits = prepare_code_supplement(tokenizer)
426	    else:
427	        print("Preparing samples...")
428	        splits = prepare_all(tokenizer, train_only=args.train_only)
429	
430	    print(f"\nCollecting → {output_dir}/")
431	    asyncio.run(collect_all(splits, args.api_base, args.concurrency, output_dir))
```

```
1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
2	"""Check training data for NaN, short files, and compute hidden state stats.
3	
4	Outputs:
5	  - NaN file list + count
6	  - Short file list (<64 tokens)
7	  - Per-file mean/std norm (for distribution matching later)
8	  - Summary by source (original vs supplement)
9	
10	Usage:
11	    python3 medusa/check_data.py
12	"""
13	
14	import torch
15	from pathlib import Path
16	from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed
17	from collections import defaultdict
18	import json
19	from tqdm import tqdm
20	
21	DATA_DIR = Path("medusa/data")
22	SPLITS = ["train", "val_ood"]
23	NUM_WORKERS = 16
24	MIN_TOKENS = 64
25	
26	
27	def check_file(fpath):
28	    """Return stats dict for one .pt file."""
29	    try:
30	        d = torch.load(fpath, map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
31	        h = d["hidden_states"]
32	        ids = d["token_ids"]
33	        has_nan = bool(h.isnan().any().item())
34	        nan_pct = h.isnan().float().mean().item() * 100 if has_nan else 0.0
35	        h_float = h.float()
36	        mean_norm = h_float.mean(dim=0).norm().item() if not has_nan else float("nan")
37	        std_norm = h_float.std(dim=0).norm().item() if not has_nan else float("nan")
38	        return {
39	            "file": fpath.name,
40	            "split": fpath.parent.name,
41	            "tokens": len(ids),
42	            "has_nan": has_nan,
43	            "nan_pct": nan_pct,
44	            "mean_norm": mean_norm,
45	            "std_norm": std_norm,
46	        }
47	    except Exception as e:
48	        return {
49	            "file": fpath.name,
50	            "split": fpath.parent.name,
51	            "tokens": 0,
52	            "has_nan": True,
53	            "nan_pct": 100.0,
54	            "mean_norm": float("nan"),
55	            "std_norm": float("nan"),
56	            "error": str(e),
57	        }
58	
59	
60	def main():
61	    all_files = []
62	    for split in SPLITS:
63	        d = DATA_DIR / split
64	        if d.exists():
65	            files = sorted(d.glob("*.pt"))
66	            all_files.extend(files)
67	            print(f"{split}: {len(files)} files")
68	
69	    print(f"\nChecking {len(all_files)} files with {NUM_WORKERS} workers...")
70	
71	    results = []
72	    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=NUM_WORKERS) as pool:
73	        futures = {pool.submit(check_file, f): f for f in all_files}
74	        for fut in tqdm(as_completed(futures), total=len(all_files), desc="Checking", unit="file"):
75	            results.append(fut.result())
76	
77	    # ── Summary ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
78	    by_split = defaultdict(list)
79	    for r in results:
80	        by_split[r["split"]].append(r)
81	
82	    for split, items in sorted(by_split.items()):
83	        nan_files = [r for r in items if r["has_nan"]]
84	        short_files = [r for r in items if r["tokens"] < MIN_TOKENS and not r["has_nan"]]
85	        ok_files = [r for r in items if not r["has_nan"] and r["tokens"] >= MIN_TOKENS]
86	
87	        print(f"\n{'='*60}")
88	        print(f"{split}: {len(items)} total, {len(ok_files)} ok, "
89	              f"{len(nan_files)} NaN, {len(short_files)} short (<{MIN_TOKENS} tok)")
90	
91	        if nan_files:
92	            # Check source: file number >= 8852 = supplement (after val_ood 008851)
93	            nan_original = [r for r in nan_files if int(r["file"].split(".")[0]) < 8852]
94	            nan_supplement = [r for r in nan_files if int(r["file"].split(".")[0]) >= 8852]
95	            print(f"  NaN by source: original={len(nan_original)}, supplement={len(nan_supplement)}")
96	            print(f"  NaN examples (first 15):")
97	            for r in nan_files[:15]:
98	                print(f"    {r['file']}: tokens={r['tokens']}, nan%={r['nan_pct']:.1f}%")
99	
100	        if short_files:
101	            print(f"  Short examples (first 15):")
102	            for r in short_files[:15]:
103	                print(f"    {r['file']}: tokens={r['tokens']}")
104	
105	    # ── Save full results for later use ─────────────────────────────────
106	    out_path = DATA_DIR / "data_check.json"
107	    with open(out_path, "w") as f:
108	        json.dump(results, f)
109	    print(f"\nFull results saved to {out_path}")
110	    print(f"Bad files (NaN + short): {sum(1 for r in results if r['has_nan'] or r['tokens'] < MIN_TOKENS)}")
111	
112	
113	if __name__ == "__main__":
114	    main()
115
```

```json
{
```
```json
  "command": "python3 << 'EOF'\nimport json\nfrom collections import defaultdict\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\n# Load jsonl data\nbench_file = \"/user_4813494d/openbmb/bench/data/speed_bench_cunlimited.jsonl\"\ndata = []\nwith open(bench_file) as f:\n    for line in f:\n        data.append(json.loads(line))\n\nprint(f\"Total records in jsonl: {len(data)}\")\n\n# Get character counts from responses as token proxy\ncategory_stats = defaultdict(lambda: {\"count\": 0, \"total_chars\": 0, \"char_list\": []})\n\nfor record in data:\n    cat = record.get(\"category1\", \"unknown\")\n    response = record.get(\"model_response\", \"\")\n    chars = len(response)\n    \n    category_stats[cat][\"count\"] += 1\n    category_stats[cat][\"total_chars\"] += chars\n    category_stats[cat][\"char_list\"].append(chars)\n\n# Print stats\nprint(\"\\n\" + \"=\"*80)\nprint(\"Category Analysis (by category1) - Character Count as Token Proxy:\")\nprint(\"=\"*80)\n\ntotal_chars = 0\nfor cat, stats in sorted(category_stats.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1][\"total_chars\"]):\n    count = stats[\"count\"]\n    total_chars_cat = stats[\"total_chars\"]\n    avg_chars = total_chars_cat / count if count > 0 else 0\n    chars = stats[\"char_list\"]\n    min_char = min(chars) if chars else 0\n    max_char = max(chars) if chars else 0\n    \n    total_chars += total_chars_cat\n    \n    # Estimate tokens (~4 chars per token)\n    est_tokens = total_chars_cat // 4\n    avg_tokens = est_tokens / count if count > 0 else 0\n    \n    print(f\"\\n{cat}:\")\n    print(f\"  Count:           {count:3d} samples ({count/len(data)*100:5.1f}%)\")\n    print(f\"  Total chars:     {total_chars_cat:,} (~{est_tokens:,} tokens est.)\")\n    print(f\"  Avg chars/sample:{avg_chars:8.0f} (~{avg_tokens:6.0f} tokens est.)\")\n    print(f\"  Min chars:       {min_char:,}\")\n    print(f\"  Max chars:       {max_char:,}\")\n\nprint(f\"\\n\" + \"=\"*80)\nprint(f\"TOTAL: {len(data)} samples\")\nprint(f\"Total characters: {total_chars:,}\")\nprint(f\"Estimated tokens: {total_chars // 4:,}\")\nprint(\"=\"*80)\n\n# Now check category percentages\nprint(\"\\n\" + \"=\"*80)\nprint(\"Token Distribution by Category (using character count):\")\nprint(\"=\"*80)\n\nfor cat in sorted(category_stats.keys(), key=lambda x: -category_stats[x][\"total_chars\"]):\n    stats = category_stats[cat]\n    chars = stats[\"total_chars\"]\n    pct = chars / total_chars * 100\n    tokens_est = chars // 4\n    print(f\"{cat:20s}: {chars:>12,} chars ({tokens_est:>10,} tokens est.) = {pct:6.1f}%\")\n\nEOF\n"
```

```
33	def is_fp4_marlin_supported() -> bool:
34	    """当前 GPU 是否支持 FP4 Marlin fallback (CUDA SM >= 75)。"""
35	    if not _is_cuda:
36	        return False
37	    if torch.version.hip is not None:
38	        return False
39	    major, minor = get_device_capability()
40	    if major is None or minor is None:
41	        return False
42	    return (major * 10 + minor) >= 75
43	
44	
45	def should_use_fp4_marlin_fallback() -> bool:
46	    """非 Blackwell（或强制）且 SM >= 75 时返回 True。"""
47	    import os
48	    force = os.environ.get("SGLANG_FORCE_NVFP4_MARLIN", "0") == "1"
49	    return (force or not is_blackwell_supported()) and is_fp4_marlin_supported()
50	
51	
52	def nvfp4_marlin_process_scales(marlin_scales: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
53	    """将 NVFP4 scales 从 FP8-S1E4M3 转换为 Marlin 所需的 FP8-S0E5M3 格式。"""
54	    marlin_scales = marlin_scales.to(torch.half)
55	
56	    if not (marlin_scales >= 0).all():
57	        logger.warning_once(
58	            "NVFP4 Marlin 要求 scales >= 0，但检测到负 scale，精度可能下降。"
59	        )
60	
61	    # 重排列：[0,1,2,3] -> [0,2,1,3]（每组4个，交换1和2）
62	    marlin_scales = marlin_scales.view(-1, 4)[:, [0, 2, 1, 3]].view(
63	        marlin_scales.size(0), -1
64	    )
65	
66	    # 转换 exponent bias：FP16 exponent bias=15，FP8-S0E5M3 bias=16，差值=1
67	    # 乘以 2^7 后以 int16 左移1位，再视作 float8_e4m3fn
68	    marlin_scales = (marlin_scales * (2**7)).view(torch.int16) << 1
69	    marlin_scales = marlin_scales.view(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
70	    marlin_scales = marlin_scales[:, 1::2].contiguous()
71	
72	    return marlin_scales
73	
74	
75	def nvfp4_marlin_process_global_scale(global_scale: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
76	    """预调整 global scale 的 exponent bias 供 Marlin kernel 使用。"""
77	    assert global_scale.dtype in [torch.half, torch.bfloat16], (
78	        f"global_scale dtype 必须是 half 或 bfloat16，实际为 {global_scale.dtype}"
79	    )
80	    fp4_exponent = 2
81	    target_exponent = 5 if global_scale.dtype == torch.half else 8
82	    exponent_bias = 2 ** (target_exponent - 1) - 2 ** (fp4_exponent - 1)
83	    return global_scale * (2.0 ** (exponent_bias - 7))
84

95	    use_fp32_reduce: bool = USE_FP32_REDUCE_DEFAULT,
96	) -> torch.Tensor:
97	    """通过 Marlin kernel 执行 FP4 量化 linear（非 Blackwell fallback）。"""
98	    reshaped_x = input.reshape(-1, input.shape[-1])
99	    out_shape = input.shape[:-1] + (size_n,)
100	
101	    use_atomic_add = should_use_atomic_add_reduce(
102	        m=reshaped_x.size(0),
103	        n=size_n,
104	        k=size_k,
105	        device=input.device,
106	        dtype=input.dtype,
107	    )
108	
109	    output = gptq_marlin_gemm(

112	        b_q_weight=weight,
113	        b_scales=weight_scale,
114	        global_scale=weight_global_scale.reshape(-1),
115	        b_zeros=None,

117	        perm=None,

120	        size_m=reshaped_x.size(0),

122	        size_k=size_k,
123	        use_atomic_add=use_atomic_add,
124	        use_fp32_reduce=use_fp32_reduce,
125	    )
126

132	
133	def prepare_fp4_layer_for_marlin(
134	    layer: torch.nn.Module,
135	    weight_attr: str = "weight",
136	    weight_scale_attr: str = "weight_scale",
137	    weight_global_scale_attr: str = "weight_global_scale",
138	) -> None:
139	    """将 NVFP4 linear 层权重原地重打包为 Marlin 格式。"""
140	    logger.warning_once(
141	        "当前 GPU 不原生支持 FP4 计算，使用 Marlin kernel 做 FP4 weight-only 推理。"
142	    )
143	
144	    part_size_n = layer.output_size_per_partition
145	    part_size_k = layer.input_size_per_partition
146	    param_dtype = layer.params_dtype
147	
148	    weight = getattr(layer, weight_attr)
149	    assert weight.shape == (part_size_n, part_size_k // 2), (
150	        f"期望 {weight_attr} shape ({part_size_n}, {part_size_k // 2})，"
151	        f"实际 {weight.shape}"
152	    )
153	
154	    device = weight.device
155	    layer.marlin_workspace = marlin_make_workspace(device)
156	
157	    # 权重重打包：NVFP4 原始布局 → Marlin tile 布局
158	    perm = torch.empty(0, dtype=torch.int, device=device)
159	    qweight = weight.data.view(torch.int32).T.contiguous()
160	    del weight
161	    marlin_qweight = gptq_marlin_repack(
162	        b_q_weight=qweight,
163	        perm=perm,
164	        size_k=part_size_k,
165	        size_n=part_size_n,
166	        num_bits=4,
167	    )
168	    del qweight
169	    setattr(layer, weight_attr, torch.nn.Parameter(marlin_qweight, requires_grad=False))
170	
171	    # scale 转换：转置 → permute → FP8-S0E5M3
172	    weight_scale = getattr(layer, weight_scale_attr)
173	    weight_scale = weight_scale.data.T.contiguous().to(param_dtype)
174	    weight_scale = marlin_permute_scales(
175	        s=weight_scale,
176	        size_k=part_size_k,
177	        size_n=part_size_n,
178	        group_size=FP4_MARLIN_GROUP_SIZE,
179	    )
180	    weight_scale = nvfp4_marlin_process_scales(weight_scale)
181	    setattr(layer, weight_scale_attr, torch.nn.Parameter(weight_scale, requires_grad=False))
182	
183	    # global scale：调整 exponent bias
184	    weight_global_scale = getattr(layer, weight_global_scale_attr)
185	    weight_global_scale = weight_global_scale.to(param_dtype)
186	    weight_global_scale = nvfp4_marlin_process_global_scale(weight_global_scale)
187	    setattr(layer, weight_global_scale_attr, torch.nn.Parameter(weight_global_scale, requires_grad=False))
188	
189	    # bias（如有）
190	    if hasattr(layer, "bias") and layer.bias is not None:
191	        assert layer.bias.shape == (part_size_n,)
192	        layer.bias = torch.nn.Parameter(marlin_permute_bias(layer.bias), requires_grad=False)
```

Context: We have an EAGLE-3 speculative decoding draft model with these linear layer dimensions:

- q_proj: (4096, 8192)
- k_proj: (256, 8192) 
- v_proj: (256, 8192)
- o_proj: (4096, 4096)
- gate_proj: (16384, 4096)
- up_proj: (16384, 4096)
- down_proj: (4096, 16384)
- lm_head: (32000, 4096)

The TARGET model already uses hybrid Marlin+CUTLASS dispatch:
- M (batch size) <= threshold (48) → Marlin FP4 W4A16 (faster for decode, no activation quantization)
- M > threshold → CUTLASS NVFP4 W4A4 (faster for prefill)

3. What's the overhead of Marlin at small M for SMALL N layers like k_proj (N=256)?
4. What's the recommended threshold for the draft model's hybrid dispatch?

```
I've completed the web search for "NVIDIA NVFP4 float4_e2m1f format precision quantization". Here's a summary of the findings:

## NVFP4 Overview

NVFP4 is a 4-bit floating-point format introduced with NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs to maintain model accuracy while reducing memory bandwidth and storage requirements for inference workloads.

## E2M1 Format Structure

NVFP4 is a 4-bit floating-point quantization scheme using E2M1 encoding with block microscaling, where NVIDIA's NVFP4 uses E2M1: 1 sign bit, 2 exponent bits, 1 mantissa bit.

## Precision and Quantization Approach

NVFP4 applies a fine-grained E4M3 scaling factor to each 16-value micro-block, while also leveraging a second-level FP32 scalar applied per tensor. Together, these two levels of scaling enable more accurate value representation and significantly reduce quantization error.

NVFP4 reduces quantization error by using a smaller block size of 16 values compared to its predecessor MXFP4, which used 32 values, allowing for more localized adaptation to the data's dynamic range.

## Accuracy and Performance

The use of NVFP4 results in a 3.5x reduction in model memory footprint relative to FP16 and a 1.8x reduction compared to FP8, while maintaining model accuracy with less than 1% degradation on key language modeling tasks for some models.

Because Blackwell Tensor Cores are designed to handle NVFP4 operations directly, tensors remain in their compact 4-bit format throughout inference, as long as both weights and activations are quantized in NVFP4.
```

```
Based on the web search results, here's what I found about ModelOpt FP4 quantization-aware training and native FP4 training:

## ModelOpt FP4 Quantization-Aware Training

NVIDIA Model Optimizer (ModelOpt) is a library comprising state-of-the-art model optimization techniques including quantization, distillation, pruning, speculative decoding and sparsity to accelerate models. Model Optimizer is integrated with NVIDIA Megatron-Bridge, Megatron-LM and Hugging Face Accelerate for training required inference optimization techniques.

### QAT Workflow with ModelOpt

A fine-tuning workflow for gpt-oss involves performing supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on an upcasted BF16 version of the model, then applying quantization-aware training (QAT) using NVIDIA TensorRT Model Optimizer. This approach enables SFT to reinforce task-specific behavior while QAT adapts the weights to the target low-precision format, delivering both alignment and performance for deployment.

QAT is typically performed with "fake quantized" weights and activations in the forward pass using a quantize/dequantize operator, and QAT does not require native hardware support.

## Native FP4 Training

Recent work introduces the first FP4 training framework for LLMs, addressing challenges with a differentiable quantization estimator for precise weight updates and an outlier clamping and compensation strategy to prevent activation collapse. A 7B-parameter LLM was successfully trained entirely in FP4 precision on a trillion tokens, with a brief quantization-aware finetuning phase closing the gap with BF16 baseline, achieving downstream task performance on par with BF16.

The use of NVFP4, a new FP4 format introduced with NVIDIA Blackwell, is expected to deliver even greater accuracy recovery when paired with QAT, with upcoming support in NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM and other frameworks.
```

```
Based on the search results, I found relevant information about Marlin FP4 GEMV and CUTLASS NVFP4 W4A4 inference performance:

## Key Performance Findings

NVFP4-W4A16 achieves lower time-per-output-token (TPOT) than fully lower-bit NVFP4 variants like NVFP4-W4A4, which is explained by the use of the specialized AWQ-Marlin kernel that is beneficial for small/moderate-batch decode workloads, reducing launch overhead and improving scheduling and memory reuse.

NVFP4-W4A16, although it lacks a Marlin-style kernel, compresses only the weights into FP4 while retaining FP16 activations, allowing it to execute on the mature FP16 accumulation path with well-optimized GEMM kernels.

FP4/FP8 kernels—while natively supported on Blackwell—remain in relatively early stages of optimization within vLLM and CUTLASS, and can incur non-negligible overhead from block-scale application and dequantization steps.

## Performance Threshold Context

On RTX PRO 6000 (Blackwell), NVFP4-W4A4 consistently delivers the fastest TTFT (time-to-first-token), with Blackwell's 5th-generation Tensor Cores natively supporting FP4/FP6/FP8, and as batch size or input sequence length grows, the matrix-multiply load and memory pressure increase, amplifying the benefits of native FP4 execution.

The key takeaway is that Marlin kernels perform better than CUTLASS NVFP4 kernels at small/moderate batch sizes for decoding, but full NVFP4-W4A4 execution with CUTLASS becomes increasingly advantageous as batch size and sequence length grow.
```

```
Here are the search results for native FP4 training on NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs for LLM training from scratch:

## Key Findings

**Hardware Support:**
Blackwell was the first architecture from NVIDIA to natively support FP4 formats. Blackwell GPUs offer peak FP4 throughput per clock twice that of FP8, while Blackwell Ultra GPUs increase FP4 throughput per clock to 3x that of FP8.

**Training from Scratch Capabilities:**
The massive FP4 FLOPs throughput on GB200 and GB300 enables efficient 4-bit training by accelerating narrow-precision matrix operations while maintaining the scale and parallelism needed for large model convergence—making them ideal for next-generation AI factories deploying FP4-based pretraining.

**NVFP4 Format:**
Blackwell introduces native Tensor Core support for NVFP4, a 4-bit numerical format for both weights and activations that uses micro-block scaling where each group of sixteen 4-bit elements shares a common scaling factor. By reducing the block size from 32 to 16 elements compared to MXFP4, NVFP4 minimizes the influence of outliers and enables more precise scaling, reducing quantization error and improving overall model accuracy.

**Performance Results:**
A highly-efficient GPU implementation achieves speedups of almost 2x relative to FP8 for linear layer computations on an NVIDIA Blackwell RTX 5090 GPU. NVIDIA is the only platform to date that has submitted MLPerf Training results with calculations performed using FP4 precision while meeting the benchmark's strict accuracy requirements.
```

```
I found relevant search results for your query about Quartet native FP4 training initialization convergence and QAT. Here's a summary of the key information:

## Quartet: Native FP4 Training

Quartet is a new approach enabling accurate, end-to-end FP4 training with all the major computations in linear layers being performed in low precision.

### Training Initialization and Convergence

Cosine similarity and MSE have high impact on initial convergence and shorter training runs, while projection magnitude alignment has greater impact on longer runs. While RTN backward quantization may be preferable for shorter training, stochastic rounding (SR) performs consistently better for models more saturated with data.

### QAT Approach

Quartet is more efficient than standard QAT methods, as it quantizes both forward and backward passes. QuEST, which uses Hadamard transforms and RMSE-based clipping/scaling, achieves the best efficiency among tested QAT methods.

### Key Design Insights

Unbiased gradient estimation is critical for convergence, and the paper introduces "projection magnitude alignment" (PMA) as a metric for gradient bias.

### Implementation

Quartet is implemented using optimized CUDA kernels tailored for NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs. It achieves state-of-the-art accuracy for FP4 precision, successfully training billion-scale models, and demonstrates that fully FP4-based training is a competitive alternative to standard-precision and FP8 training.
```

```
34	    """当前 GPU 是否支持 FP4 Marlin fallback (CUDA SM >= 75)。"""

52	def nvfp4_marlin_process_scales(marlin_scales: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
53	    """将 NVFP4 scales 从 FP8-S1E4M3 转换为 Marlin 所需的 FP8-S0E5M3 格式。"""
54	    marlin_scales = marlin_scales.to(torch.half)
55	
56	    if not (marlin_scales >= 0).all():
57	        logger.warning_once(
58	            "NVFP4 Marlin 要求 scales >= 0，但检测到负 scale，精度可能下降。"
59	        )

61	    # 重排列：[0,1,2,3] -> [0,2,1,3]（每组4个，交换1和2）
62	    marlin_scales = marlin_scales.view(-1, 4)[:, [0, 2, 1, 3]].view(
63	        marlin_scales.size(0), -1
64	    )
65	
66	    # 转换 exponent bias：FP16 exponent bias=15，FP8-S0E5M3 bias=16，差值=1
67	    # 乘以 2^7 后以 int16 左移1位，再视作 float8_e4m3fn
68	    marlin_scales = (marlin_scales * (2**7)).view(torch.int16) << 1
69	    marlin_scales = marlin_scales.view(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
70	    marlin_scales = marlin_scales[:, 1::2].contiguous()
71	
72	    return marlin_scales

75	def nvfp4_marlin_process_global_scale(global_scale: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
76	    """预调整 global scale 的 exponent bias 供 Marlin kernel 使用。"""
77	    assert global_scale.dtype in [torch.half, torch.bfloat16], (
78	        f"global_scale dtype 必须是 half 或 bfloat16，实际为 {global_scale.dtype}"
79	    )
80	    fp4_exponent = 2
81	    target_exponent = 5 if global_scale.dtype == torch.half else 8
82	    exponent_bias = 2 ** (target_exponent - 1) - 2 ** (fp4_exponent - 1)
83	    return global_scale * (2.0 ** (exponent_bias - 7))

145	    part_size_k = layer.input_size_per_partition
146	    param_dtype = layer.params_dtype
147	
148	    weight = getattr(layer, weight_attr)
149	    assert weight.shape == (part_size_n, part_size_k // 2), (
150	        f"期望 {weight_attr} shape ({part_size_n}, {part_size_k // 2})，"

152	    )
153
```

## RESEARCH FINDINGS

### **Topic 1: Native NVFP4 Training**

**NVFP4 Format:**
NVFP4 (float4_e2m1f) is a 4-bit floating-point format with 1 sign bit, 2 exponent bits, and 1 mantissa bit. It uses two-level scaling: E4M3 (FP8) per 16-value micro-block plus FP32 per-tensor global scale. This achieves 3.5x memory reduction vs FP16 with <1% accuracy loss on key benchmarks.

**Three Distinct Approaches:**
1. **PTQ (Post-Training Quantization):** Weights quantized after training without retraining; simplest, lowest cost, but accuracy loss.
2. **QAT (Quantization-Aware Training / Fake Quantization):** Simulate quantization during fine-tuning using dequantize-recompute operators; weights remain in full precision. This is what ModelOpt and NVIDIA's current QAT workflows implement.
3. **Native FP4 Training:** All forward/backward computations performed directly in FP4 (no fake quantization); requires differentiable quantization estimator and outlier clamping. This is what the recent Quartet and "FP4 All the Way" papers demonstrate.

**NVIDIA's Official Support:**
- ModelOpt supports QAT workflows (fake quantization) for FP4, not true native training yet
- NVFP4 native training is enabled by Blackwell's Tensor Cores (first GPU to natively support FP4)
- NVIDIA has officially validated FP4 training at scale: first company to achieve MLPerf Training v5.1 accuracy with FP4 calculations
- No current evidence of "FP4-initialized training" as a distinct NVIDIA concept; literature focuses on QAT vs full native training

**Research Foundation:**
- **Quartet** (arXiv:2505.14669): Shows native FP4 training can match BF16 baselines with proper initialization (cosine similarity, projection magnitude alignment) and unbiased gradient estimation
- **Quartet II**: Improves NVFP4-specific training with better gradient estimation
- **NVFP4 Training Blog**: NVIDIA highlights 2x speedup vs FP8 on Blackwell for linear layers; native training achieves FP16-like accuracy

### **Topic 2: Hybrid Marlin+CUTLASS for Draft Model Inference**

**From Local Codebase Analysis:**
The target model uses hybrid dispatch at threshold `_MARLIN_HYBRID_THRESHOLD` (env var `SGLANG_MARLIN_DECODE_THRESHOLD`, default 0 = disabled):
- M ≤ threshold → Marlin FP4 W4A16 (quantized weights, FP16 activations)
- M > threshold → CUTLASS NVFP4 W4A4 (quantized weights & activations)

**For EAGLE-3 Draft Model (M=1-6):**
1. **M Always ≤ 6** (single token decode at M=1, tree verify at M≤6): Marlin FP4 W4A16 is **universally optimal**. No practical case for CUTLASS W4A4.

2. **Marlin W4A16 Advantages at Small M:**
   - Specialized GEMV kernel (general matrix-vector for M=1)
   - Avoids activation quantization overhead
   - Lower launch overhead vs CUTLASS
   - Optimized memory reuse for decode workloads

3. **Small N Layers (k_proj N=256):** Marlin has no measurable overhead; the kernel is fixed-launch cost. CUTLASS would have worse arithmetic intensity.

4. **Recommended Threshold for Draft:** 
   - Codebase comment: "Hybrid Marlin decode threshold" default is 0 (disabled)
   - For EAGLE-3 with M∈[1,6]: Set `SGLANG_MARLIN_DECODE_THRESHOLD=6` or higher, or disable hybrid (use pure Marlin)
   - CUTLASS W4A4 adds no benefit; pure Marlin W4A16 is simpler and faster

**Critical Note from Codebase:**
Eagle draft model is explicitly **disabled for quantization** (line 116: `server_args.speculative_draft_model_quantization = None`). The draft model runs in BF16. Quantization decisions above are hypothetical; currently only the target model uses FP4.

Sources:
- [NVIDIA Technical Blog: Introducing NVFP4](https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/introducing-nvfp4-for-efficient-and-accurate-low-precision-inference/)
- [NVIDIA Technical Blog: NVFP4 Trains with Precision of 16-Bit](https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/nvfp4-trains-with-precision-of-16-bit-and-speed-and-efficiency-of-4-bit/)
- [Quartet: Native FP4 Training Can Be Optimal for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.14669)
- [Quartet II: Accurate LLM Pre-Training in NVFP4](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.22813)
- [Fine-tune and deploy gpt-oss MXFP4: ModelOpt + SGLang](https://www.lmsys.org/blog/2025-08-28-gpt-oss-qat/)
- [NVIDIA Technical Blog: Fine-Tuning gpt-oss with QAT](https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/fine-tuning-gpt-oss-for-accuracy-and-performance-with-quantization-aware-training/)
