150	## Hybrid Marlin/CUTLASS Decode Optimization
151	
152	### Status: implemented, local verified, platform probe passed
153	
154	Hybrid dispatch in `modelopt_quant.py`: M <= threshold → Marlin FP4 GEMV (W4A16, no activation quantization), M > threshold → NVFP4 CUTLASS (W4A4). Zero precision loss — Marlin decode activations stay BF16.
155	
156	### Environment Variable
157	
158	`SGLANG_MARLIN_DECODE_THRESHOLD=48` — configurable. Set to 0 or unset for pure CUTLASS. Replaces old `SGLANG_FORCE_NVFP4_MARLIN=1` (full Marlin, still supported for backward compat).
159	
160	### Implementation
161	
162	- `process_weights_after_loading`: CUTLASS prep (weight_scale_interleaved) runs first, then `_prepare_hybrid_marlin` creates Marlin weights (weight_marlin, weight_scale_marlin, weight_global_scale_marlin) from the still-intact originals. Both formats coexist. Extra VRAM: ~4 GB.
163	- `apply()`: `if M <= threshold → Marlin`, else → CUTLASS. CUDA graph safe (separate graph per batch size).
164	- Crossover measured on real weights: gate_proj M≈48, down_proj M≈128-256. threshold=48 is net positive across all projections.
165	
166	### sgl-kernel Fix
167	
168	- Old kernel's `marlin_template.h` had FP4 scale `/2` bug → cos_sim 0.77
169	- Fix: pre-built `common_ops.abi3.so` (75 MB, SM 120a only) replaces platform .so via `cp`
170	- No more cmake build needed — saves ~10 min and 980 MB deps
171	
172	### Offline Verification
173	
174	- Correctness: 21 projections × 3 layers, Marlin vs CUTLASS cos_sim min=0.992, mean=0.995
175	- Consistency: hybrid dispatch matches individual paths at threshold boundary
176	- Throughput: decode M=1 gate_proj 2.4x faster, down_proj 5.2x faster vs CUTLASS
177

179	
180	| Package | Size | Content |
181	|---------|------|---------|
182	| `demo-sala.tar.gz` | ~225 MB | 正式提交: loguniform128/48K quant + Medusa K=1 + hybrid Marlin |
183	| `probe-sala.tar.gz` | ~95 MB | 平台自测: 全量量化+eval + NaN 检测 + FlashInfer/cuDNN 升级, exit(1) |

197	## Negative Results
198	
199	| Approach | Result | Why |
200	|----------|--------|-----|
201	| fp8 KV cache | no gain | Smax bottleneck is mamba slots, not KV memory |
202	| mamba cache quant (INT8/4) | not viable | cumulative error in temporal state |
203	| radix cache | no gain | bench flushes cache between tiers |
204	| Triton NVFP4 GEMV | 2.6x slower | 809 vs 307 us/layer vs CUTLASS |
205	| FP8 decode | no gain | 1.78x larger weights cancel bandwidth gain |
206	| INT4 AWQ route | abandoned | unpack convention complexity |
207	| Full Marlin (no hybrid) | prefill 3.8x slower | at M=8192 vs CUTLASS |
208	| pre_quant_scale fusion | not worth | CUDA graph eliminates launch overhead; swizzled scale format opaque |
209	| SimpleGLA BK=128 kernel | 1.65x slower | eager 1.9x gain was illusion (Python overhead); CUDA graph reveals truth |
210	| Medusa K=3 | marginal | 1.543 vs 1.356 tok/step, 2x GLA overhead. K=1 better |
211	| Triton kv_indices kernel | 0.78x slower | `.item()` on CPU tensors, no GPU sync to save |

213	## Operator Optimizations (Implemented)
214	
215	| Optimization | Decode gain | Prefill gain | Safety |
216	|-------------|------------|-------------|--------|
217	| RoPE F32 cast elimination | 140us/fwd (3.5x) | 11.2ms/fwd (4.5x) | sgl_kernel RoPE internally F32; cos_sim=1.0 |
218	| Residual fused multiply-add | 237us/fwd (2.15x) | 4.4ms/fwd (5.76x) | Strictly more precise vs F64 ground truth |
219	| Absorb scale_emb/width into weights | ~2 kernels eliminated | ~284us/fwd | Exact math (BF16-representable scalars) |
220	| In-place sigmoid*mul gate | memory pressure reduced | — | Mathematically identical; tensors not reused |
221	| GLA backend cleanup | ~24us | — | Remove redundant .contiguous() + cache lookups |

```
21	    b_q_weight: torch.Tensor, size_k: int, size_n: int, num_bits: int
22	) -> torch.Tensor:

26	def awq_marlin_moe_repack(
27	    b_q_weight: torch.Tensor,
28	    perm: torch.Tensor,
29	    size_k: int,
30	    size_n: int,
31	    num_bits: int,
32	) -> torch.Tensor:
33	    num_experts = b_q_weight.shape[0]
34	    assert size_k % 16 == 0
35	    output = torch.empty(
36	        (num_experts, size_k // 16, size_n * (num_bits // 2)),
37	        device=b_q_weight.device,
38	        dtype=b_q_weight.dtype,
39	    )
40	    for e in range(num_experts):
41	        output[e] = torch.ops.sgl_kernel.awq_marlin_repack(
42	            b_q_weight[e], size_k, size_n, num_bits
43	        )
44	    return output
```

```
def _compute_swizzled_layout_sf_size(total_row, total_column, row_size=128):
    padded_row = round_up(total_row, row_size)
    padded_column = round_up(total_column, 4)
    return padded_row * padded_column


def _pad_scale_factors(
    unswizzled_sf: torch.Tensor, m: int, n: int, sf_vec_size: int = 16
) -> torch.Tensor:
    """Pad scale factors tensor to meet alignment requirements.

    Args:
        unswizzled_sf (torch.Tensor): Input scale factors tensor with dtype uint8.
        m (int): M dimension.
        n (int): N dimension.
        sf_vec_size (int, optional): Scale factor vector size. Defaults to 16.

    Returns:
        torch.Tensor: Padded scale factors tensor.
    """
    factor = sf_vec_size * 4
    padded_row = round_up(m, 128)
    padded_col = round_up(n, factor)

    # Pad the input tensor to [padded_row, padded_col // scaling_vector_size]
    pad_rows = padded_row - m
    pad_cols = (padded_col - n) // sf_vec_size
    if pad_rows == 0 and pad_cols == 0:
        return unswizzled_sf
    else:
        return torch.nn.functional.pad(
            unswizzled_sf, (0, pad_cols, 0, pad_rows), mode="constant", value=0
        ).contiguous()


def gen_fp4_quantization_sm100_module() -> JitSpec:
    return gen_fp4_quantization_module(sm100a_nvcc_flags, "100")


def gen_fp4_quantization_sm103_module() -> JitSpec:

def gen_fp4_quantization_sm110_module() -> JitSpec:
```

```
102	        m=reshaped_x.size(0),
103	        n=size_n,
104	        k=size_k,
105	        device=input.device,
106	        dtype=input.dtype,
107	    )
108	
109	    output = gptq_marlin_gemm(
110	        a=reshaped_x,
111	        c=None,
112	        b_q_weight=weight,
113	        b_scales=weight_scale,
114	        global_scale=weight_global_scale.reshape(-1),
115	        b_zeros=None,
116	        g_idx=None,
117	        perm=None,
118	        workspace=workspace,
119	        b_q_type=scalar_types.float4_e2m1f,
120	        size_m=reshaped_x.size(0),
121	        size_n=size_n,
122	        size_k=size_k,
123	        use_atomic_add=use_atomic_add,
124	        use_fp32_reduce=use_fp32_reduce,
125	    )
126	
127	    if bias is not None:
128	        output.add_(bias)
129	
130	    return output.reshape(out_shape)

132	
133	def prepare_fp4_layer_for_marlin(
134	    layer: torch.nn.Module,
135	    weight_attr: str = "weight",
136	    weight_scale_attr: str = "weight_scale",
137	    weight_global_scale_attr: str = "weight_global_scale",
138	) -> None:
139	    """将 NVFP4 linear 层权重原地重打包为 Marlin 格式。"""
140	    logger.warning_once(
141	        "当前 GPU 不原生支持 FP4 计算，使用 Marlin kernel 做 FP4 weight-only 推理。"
142	    )
143	
144	    part_size_n = layer.output_size_per_partition
145	    part_size_k = layer.input_size_per_partition
146	    param_dtype = layer.params_dtype
147	
148	    weight = getattr(layer, weight_attr)
149	    assert weight.shape == (part_size_n, part_size_k // 2), (
150	        f"期望 {weight_attr} shape ({part_size_n}, {part_size_k // 2})，"
151	        f"实际 {weight.shape}"
152	    )
153	
154	    device = weight.device
155	    layer.marlin_workspace = marlin_make_workspace(device)
156	
157	    # 权重重打包：NVFP4 原始布局 → Marlin tile 布局
158	    perm = torch.empty(0, dtype=torch.int, device=device)
159	    qweight = weight.data.view(torch.int32).T.contiguous()
160	    del weight
161	    marlin_qweight = gptq_marlin_repack(
162	        b_q_weight=qweight,
163	        perm=perm,
164	        size_k=part_size_k,
165	        size_n=part_size_n,
166	        num_bits=4,
167	    )
168	    del qweight
169	    setattr(layer, weight_attr, torch.nn.Parameter(marlin_qweight, requires_grad=False))
170	
171	    # scale 转换：转置 → permute → FP8-S0E5M3
172	    weight_scale = getattr(layer, weight_scale_attr)
173	    weight_scale = weight_scale.data.T.contiguous().to(param_dtype)
174	    weight_scale = marlin_permute_scales(
175	        s=weight_scale,
176	        size_k=part_size_k,
177	        size_n=part_size_n,
178	        group_size=FP4_MARLIN_GROUP_SIZE,
179	    )
180	    weight_scale = nvfp4_marlin_process_scales(weight_scale)
181	    setattr(layer, weight_scale_attr, torch.nn.Parameter(weight_scale, requires_grad=False))
182	
183	    # global scale：调整 exponent bias
184	    weight_global_scale = getattr(layer, weight_global_scale_attr)
185	    weight_global_scale = weight_global_scale.to(param_dtype)
186	    weight_global_scale = nvfp4_marlin_process_global_scale(weight_global_scale)
187	    setattr(layer, weight_global_scale_attr, torch.nn.Parameter(weight_global_scale, requires_grad=False))
188	
189	    # bias（如有）
190	    if hasattr(layer, "bias") and layer.bias is not None:
191	        assert layer.bias.shape == (part_size_n,)
192	        layer.bias = torch.nn.Parameter(marlin_permute_bias(layer.bias), requires_grad=False)
193
```

```
76	// For a given "a" of size [M,K] performs a permutation of the K columns based
77	// on the given "perm" indices.
78	__global__ void permute_cols_kernel(
79	    int4 const* __restrict__ a_int4_ptr,
80	    int const* __restrict__ perm_int_ptr,
81	    int4* __restrict__ out_int4_ptr,
82	    int size_m,
83	    int size_k,
84	    int lda,
85	    int block_rows) {
86	  auto start_row = block_rows * blockIdx.x;
87	  int finish_row = start_row + block_rows;
88	  if (finish_row > size_m) {
89	    finish_row = size_m;
90	  }
91	  int cur_block_rows = finish_row - start_row;
92	
93	  int input_row_stride = lda * sizeof(half) / 16;
94	  int output_row_stride = size_k * sizeof(half) / 16;
95	
96	  auto permute_row = [&](int row) {
97	    int iters = size_k / default_threads;
98	    int rest = size_k % default_threads;
99	
100	    int input_offset = row * input_row_stride;
101	    int output_offset = row * output_row_stride;
102	
103	    half const* a_row_half = reinterpret_cast<half const*>(a_int4_ptr + input_offset);
104	    half* out_half = reinterpret_cast<half*>(out_int4_ptr + output_offset);
105	
106	    int base_k = 0;
107	
108	    for (int i = 0; i < iters; i++) {
109	      auto cur_k = base_k + threadIdx.x;
110	      int src_pos = perm_int_ptr[cur_k];
111	
112	      out_half[cur_k] = a_row_half[src_pos];
113	
114	      base_k += default_threads;
115	    }
116	
117	    if (rest) {
118	      if (threadIdx.x < rest) {
119	        auto cur_k = base_k + threadIdx.x;
120	        int src_pos = perm_int_ptr[cur_k];
121	
122	        out_half[cur_k] = a_row_half[src_pos];
123	      }
124	    }
125	  };
126	
127	  for (int i = 0; i < cur_block_rows; i++) {
128	    int cur_row = start_row + i;
129	    if (cur_row < size_m) {
130	      permute_row(cur_row);
131	    }
132	  }
133	}
134

162	int get_scales_cache_size(
163	    thread_config_t const& th_config,
164	    int prob_m,
165	    int prob_n,
166	    int prob_k,
167	    int num_bits,
168	    int group_size,
169	    bool has_act_order,
170	    bool is_k_full) {
171	  bool cache_scales_chunk = has_act_order && !is_k_full;
172	
173	  int tb_n = th_config.thread_n;
174	  int tb_k = th_config.thread_k;
175	
176	  // Get max scale groups per thread-block
177	  int tb_groups;
178	  if (group_size == -1) {
179	    tb_groups = 1;
180	  } else if (group_size == 0) {
181	    tb_groups = div_ceil(tb_k, 32);  // Worst case is 32 group size
182	  } else {
183	    tb_groups = div_ceil(tb_k, group_size);
184	  }
185	
186	  if (cache_scales_chunk) {
187	    int load_groups = tb_groups * pipe_stages * 2;  // Chunk size is 2x pipeline over dim K
188	    load_groups = max(load_groups, 32);             // We load at least 32 scale groups
189	    return load_groups * tb_n * 2;
190	  } else {
191	    int tb_scales = tb_groups * tb_n * 2;
192	
193	    return tb_scales * pipe_stages;
194	  }
195	}
```

```
211	  // Get B size
212	  int tb_k = th_config.thread_k;
213	  int tb_n = th_config.thread_n;
214	  int tb_m = thread_m_blocks * 16;
215	  int sh_a_size = pipe_stages * (tb_m * tb_k) * 2;
216	  int sh_b_size = pipe_stages * (tb_k * tb_n / pack_factor) * 4;
217	  int sh_red_size = tb_m * (tb_n + 8);
218	  int sh_s_size =
219	      get_scales_cache_size(th_config, prob_m, prob_n, prob_k, num_bits, group_size, has_act_order, is_k_full);
220	  int sh_g_idx_size = has_act_order && !is_k_full ? pipe_stages * tb_k / 4 : 0;
221	  int sh_zp_size = 0;
222	  if (has_zp) {
223	    if (is_zp_float)
224	      sh_zp_size = sh_s_size;
225	    else if (num_bits == 4)
226	      sh_zp_size = sh_s_size / 4;
227	    else if (num_bits == 8)
228	      sh_zp_size = sh_s_size / 2;
229	  }
230	
231	  int total_size = max(sh_b_size, sh_red_size) + sh_a_size + sh_s_size + sh_zp_size + sh_g_idx_size;
232	
233	  return total_size;
234	}
235	
236	bool is_valid_config(
237	    thread_config_t const& th_config,
238	    int thread_m_blocks,
239	    int prob_m,
240	    int prob_n,
241	    int prob_k,
242	    int num_bits,
243	    int group_size,
244	    bool has_act_order,
245	    bool is_k_full,
246	    int has_zp,
247	    int is_zp_float,
248	    int max_shared_mem) {
249	  // Sanity
250	  if (th_config.thread_k == -1 || th_config.thread_n == -1 || th_config.num_threads == -1) {
251	    return false;
252	  }
253	
254	  // Verify K/N are divisible by thread K/N
255	  if (prob_k % th_config.thread_k != 0 || prob_n % th_config.thread_n != 0) {
256	    return false;
257	  }
258	
259	  // Verify min for thread K/N
260	  if (th_config.thread_n < min_thread_n || th_config.thread_k < min_thread_k) {
261	    return false;
262	  }
263	
264	  // num_threads must be at least 128 (= 4 warps)
265	  if (th_config.num_threads < 128) {
266	    return false;
267	  }
268	
269	  // Check that pipeline fits into cache
270	  int cache_size = get_kernel_cache_size(
271	      th_config,
272	      thread_m_blocks,
273	      prob_m,
274	      prob_n,
275	      prob_k,
276	      num_bits,
277	      group_size,
278	      has_act_order,
279	      is_k_full,
280	      has_zp,
281	      is_zp_float);
282	  return cache_size <= max_shared_mem;
283	}
```

```
59	  int64_t const required_workspace_size = gemmRunner.getWorkspaceSize(m, n, k, batch_count);
60	  int64_t const provided_workspace_size =
61	      workspace_buffer.numel() * get_element_size(workspace_buffer);
62	
63	  auto runKernel = [&](void* workspace) {
64	    gemmRunner.gemm(out.data_ptr(), mat1.data_ptr(), mat2.data_ptr(), mat1Scale.data_ptr(),
65	                    mat2Scale.data_ptr(), static_cast<float*>(globalScale.data_ptr()), m, n, k,
66	                    batch_count, gemmConfig, reinterpret_cast<char*>(workspace),
67	                    required_workspace_size, get_stream(mat1.device()));
68	  };
69	
70	  if (provided_workspace_size < required_workspace_size) {
71	    Tensor new_workspace =
72	        alloc_tensor({required_workspace_size}, DLDataType{kDLInt, 8, 1}, mat1.device());
73	    runKernel(new_workspace.data_ptr());
74	  } else {
75	    runKernel(workspace_buffer.data_ptr());
76	  }
77	}
```

```
62	scales_cutlass = weight_scale_raw.unsqueeze(0).cuda()  # (1, N, scale_cols)

66	K_padded = round_up(K_s, 4)

68	padded_scales[:B_s, :M_s, :K_s] = scales_cutlass
69	padded_scales = padded_scales.reshape(B_s, M_padded // 128, 4, 32, K_padded // 4, 4)
```

```
1	"""NVFP4 GEMV kernel v2 — optimized for M=1 decode on Blackwell.
2	
3	Key optimization vs v1:
4	- Load x into shared memory once, broadcast to all N outputs
5	- Use 1D weight loads (contiguous along N) instead of 2D gathers
6	- Each program handles one row of N outputs for ALL of K
7	- Row-major weight layout: W (N, K//2) — avoids column-major scatter
8	"""
9	
10	import torch
11	import triton
12	import triton.language as tl
13	import time
14	
15	
16	@triton.jit
17	def _nvfp4_gemv_v2(
18	    X_ptr,          # (K,) bf16 input vector
19	    W_ptr,          # (N, K//2) uint8 packed FP4 weights — ROW MAJOR
20	    S_ptr,          # (N, K//16) fp8 block scales — ROW MAJOR
21	    Y_ptr,          # (N,) bf16 output
22	    alpha_ptr,      # float32 global scale
23	    K: tl.constexpr,
24	    N: tl.constexpr,
25	    BLOCK_N: tl.constexpr,
26	    BLOCK_K: tl.constexpr,
27	):
28	    pid = tl.program_id(0)
29	    n_start = pid * BLOCK_N
30	    n_offs = n_start + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_N)
31	    n_mask = n_offs < N
32	
33	    alpha = tl.load(alpha_ptr)
34	    acc = tl.zeros((BLOCK_N,), dtype=tl.float32)
35	
36	    half_K = K // 2
37	
38	    for k_start in range(0, K, BLOCK_K):
39	        # Load x even/odd positions
40	        k_even = k_start + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_K // 2) * 2
41	        k_odd = k_even + 1
42	        x_even = tl.load(X_ptr + k_even, mask=k_even < K, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
43	        x_odd = tl.load(X_ptr + k_odd, mask=k_odd < K, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
44	
45	        # Load packed weights: W[n, k_byte] row-major
46	        # offset = n * (K//2) + k_byte
47	        k_byte_start = k_start // 2
48	        k_byte_offs = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_K // 2)
49	        # 2D load: (BLOCK_N, BLOCK_K//2)
50	        w_offsets = n_offs[:, None] * half_K + (k_byte_start + k_byte_offs)[None, :]
51	        w_packed = tl.load(W_ptr + w_offsets, mask=n_mask[:, None], other=0)
52	
53	        # Unpack
54	        w_lo = w_packed & 0x0F
55	        w_hi = (w_packed >> 4) & 0x0F
56	
57	        # Inline FP4 E2M1 decode
58	        v_lo = w_lo.to(tl.int32)
59	        sign_lo = (v_lo >> 3) & 1
60	        exp_lo = (v_lo >> 1) & 3
61	        man_lo = v_lo & 1
62	        is_sub_lo = (exp_lo == 0)
63	        normal_lo = (1.0 + man_lo.to(tl.float32)) * tl.exp2((exp_lo - 1).to(tl.float32))
64	        sub_lo = man_lo.to(tl.float32) * 0.5
65	        abs_lo = tl.where(is_sub_lo, sub_lo, normal_lo)
66	        w_even = tl.where(sign_lo == 1, -abs_lo, abs_lo)
67	
68	        v_hi = w_hi.to(tl.int32)
69	        sign_hi = (v_hi >> 3) & 1
70	        exp_hi = (v_hi >> 1) & 3
71	        man_hi = v_hi & 1
72	        is_sub_hi = (exp_hi == 0)
73	        normal_hi = (1.0 + man_hi.to(tl.float32)) * tl.exp2((exp_hi - 1).to(tl.float32))
74	        sub_hi = man_hi.to(tl.float32) * 0.5
75	        abs_hi = tl.where(is_sub_hi, sub_hi, normal_hi)
76	        w_odd = tl.where(sign_hi == 1, -abs_hi, abs_hi)
77	
78	        # Load block scales: S[n, s_idx] row-major
79	        scale_K = K // 16
80	        s_start = k_start // 16
81	        s_local = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_K // 2) // 8  # constexpr
82	        s_offsets = n_offs[:, None] * scale_K + (s_start + s_local)[None, :]
83	        scales = tl.load(S_ptr + s_offsets, mask=n_mask[:, None], other=1.0).to(tl.float32)
84	
85	        w_even = w_even * scales
86	        w_odd = w_odd * scales
87	
88	        # Dot product: acc[n] += sum_k(x[k] * w[n, k])
89	        acc += tl.sum(w_even * x_even[None, :], axis=1)
90	        acc += tl.sum(w_odd * x_odd[None, :], axis=1)
91	
92	    acc = acc * alpha
93	    tl.store(Y_ptr + n_offs, acc.to(tl.bfloat16), mask=n_mask)
94	
95

98	    x: (1, K) or (K,) bf16

100	    w_scales: (N, K//16) fp8_e4m3 ROW-MAJOR
101	    alpha: (1,) float32

103	    x_flat = x.view(-1)
104	    y = torch.empty(1, N, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=x.device)

106	    BLOCK_N = 64

113	        K=K, N=N,
114	        BLOCK_N=BLOCK_N,
115	        BLOCK_K=BLOCK_K,
116	    )
117	    return y
```

```
1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
2	"""NVFP4 SplitK GEMV: increase SM utilization for small-N projections.
3	
4	Strategy: Split K dimension into SPLIT_K chunks, each handled by a separate TB.
5	This multiplies the TB count by SPLIT_K, filling more SMs.
6	
7	For down_proj (K=16384, N=4096):
8	  - Current: 32 TBs → 21% SM utilization
9	  - SplitK=4: 128 TBs → 82% SM utilization
10	  - SplitK=8: 256 TBs → 164% SM utilization
11	
12	Implementation: dequantize NVFP4→BF16 on-the-fly, then use cuBLAS GEMV on chunks.
13	This tests if the bottleneck is truly SM occupancy (not dequant overhead).
14	"""
15	import torch
16	import flashinfer
17	import triton
18	import triton.language as tl
19	
20	SM_COUNT = torch.cuda.get_device_properties(0).multi_processor_count
21	HBM_BW = 1128
22	DTYPE = torch.bfloat16
23	
24	print(f"GPU: {torch.cuda.get_device_name(0)}, SMs: {SM_COUNT}")
25	
26	# FP4 E2M1 lookup table: 4-bit index → float value
27	# E2M1: sign(1) exp(2) mantissa(1), bias=1
28	# Values: 0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0, 6.0 (positive)
29	#         0, -0.5, -1.0, -1.5, -2.0, -3.0, -4.0, -6.0 (negative)
30	FP4_LUT = torch.tensor([
31	    0.0, 1.0, 0.5, 1.5, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0, 6.0,    # 0000-0111
32	    0.0, -1.0, -0.5, -1.5, -2.0, -3.0, -4.0, -6.0  # 1000-1111
33	], dtype=torch.float32)
34	
35	
36	def dequant_nvfp4_to_bf16(weight_fp4, weight_scale, weight_scale_2, block_size=16):
37	    """Dequantize NVFP4 packed uint8 → BF16.
38	
39	    weight_fp4: (N, K//2) uint8, two FP4 values per byte
40	    weight_scale: (N, K//block_size) float8_e4m3fn
41	    weight_scale_2: scalar float32 (global scale)
42	    Returns: (N, K) BF16
43	    """
44	    N, K_half = weight_fp4.shape
45	    K = K_half * 2
46	
47	    # Unpack two FP4 values per byte
48	    lo = (weight_fp4 & 0x0F).to(torch.int64)  # lower nibble
49	    hi = (weight_fp4 >> 4).to(torch.int64)     # upper nibble
50	
51	    lut = FP4_LUT.to(weight_fp4.device)
52	    lo_val = lut[lo]  # (N, K//2) float32
53	    hi_val = lut[hi]  # (N, K//2) float32
54	
55	    # Interleave: each byte produces two consecutive values
56	    result = torch.empty(N, K, dtype=torch.float32, device=weight_fp4.device)
57	    result[:, 0::2] = lo_val
58	    result[:, 1::2] = hi_val
59	
60	    # Apply block scales
61	    # weight_scale: (N, K//block_size) FP8 → float
62	    scales = weight_scale.to(torch.float32)  # (N, K//block_size)
63	    # Expand scales to match K dimension
64	    scales = scales.unsqueeze(-1).expand(-1, -1, block_size).reshape(N, K)
65	
66	    # Apply global scale
67	    result = result * scales * weight_scale_2.float()
68	
69	    return result.to(DTYPE)
70	
71	
72	def approach1_dequant_cublas(M, K, N, split_k=1):
73	    """Approach 1: Dequant NVFP4→BF16 upfront, then cuBLAS GEMV.
74	
75	    This measures: if we had a fused dequant+GEMV, what's the BW ceiling?
76	    The dequant cost is the overhead we pay.
77	    """
78	    # Create NVFP4 data
79	    w_bf16_orig = torch.randn(N, K, dtype=DTYPE, device="cuda") * 0.1
80	    gsf = torch.tensor([1.0], dtype=torch.float32, device="cuda")
81	    w_fp4, w_sf = flashinfer.nvfp4_quantize(w_bf16_orig, gsf)
82	
83	    # Pre-dequantize to BF16 (simulating what a fused kernel would do on-the-fly)
84	    # For benchmark, we just pre-dequantize
85	    w_bf16 = dequant_nvfp4_to_bf16(w_fp4, w_sf, gsf)
86	    a = torch.randn(M, K, dtype=DTYPE, device="cuda")
87	
88	    # Benchmark cuBLAS GEMM on the dequantized weights
89	    def fn():
90	        torch.mm(a, w_bf16.t())
91	
92	    for _ in range(100):
93	        fn()
94	    torch.cuda.synchronize()
95	    s = torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True)
96	    e = torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True)
97	    s.record()
98	    for _ in range(500):
99	        fn()
100	    e.record()
101	    torch.cuda.synchronize()
102	    gemv_us = s.elapsed_time(e) / 500 * 1000
103	
104	    # Also benchmark dequant alone
105	    def dq():
106	        dequant_nvfp4_to_bf16(w_fp4, w_sf, gsf)
107	
108	    for _ in range(20):
109	        dq()
110	    torch.cuda.synchronize()
111	    s.record()
112	    for _ in range(100):
113	        dq()
114	    e.record()
115	    torch.cuda.synchronize()
116	    dq_us = s.elapsed_time(e) / 100 * 1000
117	
118	    return gemv_us, dq_us

120	
121	def approach2_splitk_chunks(M, K, N, split_k):
122	    """Approach 2: Split K into chunks, run parallel cuBLAS GEMVs, reduce.
123	
124	    Each chunk processes K/split_k elements, increasing parallelism.
125	    """
126	    a = torch.randn(M, K, dtype=DTYPE, device="cuda")
127	    w = torch.randn(N, K, dtype=DTYPE, device="cuda")  # Use pre-dequantized BF16
128	
129	    chunk_k = K // split_k
130	    # Pre-split tensors
131	    a_chunks = [a[:, i*chunk_k:(i+1)*chunk_k].contiguous() for i in range(split_k)]
132	    w_chunks = [w[:, i*chunk_k:(i+1)*chunk_k].t().contiguous() for i in range(split_k)]
133	
134	    def fn():
135	        results = [torch.mm(a_chunks[i], w_chunks[i]) for i in range(split_k)]
136	        out = results[0]
137	        for r in results[1:]:
138	            out = out + r
139	        return out
140	
141	    for _ in range(100):
142	        fn()
143	    torch.cuda.synchronize()
144	    s = torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True)
145	    e = torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True)
146	    s.record()
147	    for _ in range(300):
148	        fn()
149	    e.record()
150	    torch.cuda.synchronize()
151	    return s.elapsed_time(e) / 300 * 1000
152	
153	
154	def approach3_fp8_splitk(M, K, N, split_k):
155	    """Approach 3: FP8 with splitK (upper bound for NVFP4 fused)."""
156	    a = torch.randn(M, K, dtype=DTYPE, device="cuda").to(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
157	    w = torch.randn(N, K, dtype=DTYPE, device="cuda").to(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
158	    sa = torch.tensor(1.0, dtype=torch.float32, device="cuda")
159	    sb = torch.tensor(1.0, dtype=torch.float32, device="cuda")
160	
161	    chunk_k = K // split_k
162	    a_chunks = [a[:, i*chunk_k:(i+1)*chunk_k].contiguous() for i in range(split_k)]
163	    w_chunks = [w[:, i*chunk_k:(i+1)*chunk_k].t() for i in range(split_k)]
164	
165	    def fn():
166	        results = [torch._scaled_mm(a_chunks[i], w_chunks[i], scale_a=sa, scale_b=sb,
167	                                      out_dtype=DTYPE) for i in range(split_k)]
168	        out = results[0]
169	        for r in results[1:]:
170	            out = out + r
171	        return out
172	
173	    for _ in range(100):
174	        fn()
175	    torch.cuda.synchronize()
176	    s = torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True)
177	    e = torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True)
178	    s.record()
179	    for _ in range(300):
180	        fn()
181	    e.record()
182	    torch.cuda.synchronize()
183	    return s.elapsed_time(e) / 300 * 1000
184	
185	
186	def main():
187	    M = 1
188	
189	    # === Test on down_proj (worst case) ===
190	    print(f"\n{'='*100}")
191	    print(f"down_proj (K=16384, N=4096) — SplitK study, M={M}")
192	    print(f"{'='*100}")
193	
194	    K, N = 16384, 4096
195	
196	    # Baseline: NVFP4 CUTLASS
197	    a_bf16 = torch.randn(M, K, dtype=DTYPE, device="cuda") * 0.5
198	    w_bf16 = torch.randn(N, K, dtype=DTYPE, device="cuda") * 0.1
199	    gsf = torch.tensor([1.0], dtype=torch.float32, device="cuda")
200	    a_fp4, a_sf = flashinfer.nvfp4_quantize(a_bf16, gsf)
201	    w_fp4, w_sf = flashinfer.nvfp4_quantize(w_bf16, gsf)
202	    wt = w_fp4.t().contiguous()
203	    wst = w_sf.t().contiguous()
204	    alpha = torch.tensor([1.0], dtype=torch.float32, device="cuda")
205	
206	    def nvfp4_baseline():
207	        flashinfer.mm_fp4(a_fp4, wt, a_sf, wst, alpha=alpha,
208	                          out_dtype=DTYPE, backend="cutlass")
209	
210	    for _ in range(100):
211	        nvfp4_baseline()
212	    torch.cuda.synchronize()
213	    s = torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True)
214	    e = torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True)
215	    s.record()
216	    for _ in range(500):
217	        nvfp4_baseline()
218	    e.record()
219	    torch.cuda.synchronize()
220	    baseline_us = s.elapsed_time(e) / 500 * 1000
221	
222	    print(f"  NVFP4 CUTLASS baseline: {baseline_us:.1f} us (22% BW)")
223	
224	    # Approach 1: dequant + cuBLAS
225	    gemv_us, dq_us = approach1_dequant_cublas(M, K, N)
226	    print(f"  Dequant NVFP4→BF16:     {dq_us:.1f} us (offline)")
227	    print(f"  cuBLAS GEMV (on BF16):   {gemv_us:.1f} us")
228	    print(f"  Dequant + GEMV total:    {dq_us + gemv_us:.1f} us")
229	
230	    # Approach 2: BF16 splitK
231	    print(f"\n  BF16 cuBLAS splitK:")
232	    for sk in [1, 2, 4, 8, 16]:
233	        us = approach2_splitk_chunks(M, K, N, sk)
234	        tbs = sk * ((N + 127) // 128)
235	        print(f"    splitK={sk:>2}: {us:8.1f} us  (est TBs ~{tbs})")
236	
237	    # Approach 3: FP8 splitK
238	    print(f"\n  FP8 torch._scaled_mm splitK:")
239	    for sk in [1, 2, 4, 8]:
240	        if K // sk >= 128:  # minimum chunk
241	            us = approach3_fp8_splitk(M, K, N, sk)
242	            print(f"    splitK={sk:>2}: {us:8.1f} us")
243	
244	    # === Same for o_proj ===
245	    print(f"\n{'='*100}")
246	    print(f"o_proj (K=4096, N=4096) — SplitK study, M={M}")
247	    print(f"{'='*100}")
248	    K, N = 4096, 4096
249

251	    w_bf16 = torch.randn(N, K, dtype=DTYPE, device="cuda") * 0.1
252	    a_fp4, a_sf = flashinfer.nvfp4_quantize(a_bf16, gsf)
253	    w_fp4, w_sf = flashinfer.nvfp4_quantize(w_bf16, gsf)
254	    wt = w_fp4.t().contiguous()
255	    wst = w_sf.t().contiguous()
256	
257	    def nvfp4_baseline2():
258	        flashinfer.mm_fp4(a_fp4, wt, a_sf, wst, alpha=alpha,
259	                          out_dtype=DTYPE, backend="cutlass")
260	
261	    for _ in range(100):
262	        nvfp4_baseline2()
263	    torch.cuda.synchronize()
264	    s.record()
265	    for _ in range(500):
266	        nvfp4_baseline2()
267	    e.record()
268	    torch.cuda.synchronize()
269	    baseline_us = s.elapsed_time(e) / 500 * 1000
270	    print(f"  NVFP4 CUTLASS baseline: {baseline_us:.1f} us")
271	
272	    print(f"\n  BF16 cuBLAS splitK:")

275	        print(f"    splitK={sk:>2}: {us:8.1f} us")
```

```
# SM120 (Blackwell Consumer, RTX 6000D) Specifications:

## Key Specs
- Compute Capability: 12.0
- Memory Bandwidth: 960 GB/s (standard) to 1128 GB/s (peak)
- L2 Cache: 96 MB
- Tensor Cores: BF16, FP8, TF32, FP32
- Max Threads per Block: 1024
- Max Registers per Block: 65536
- Shared Memory per Block: 96-192 KB

## Native Operations
- BF16 tensor cores: yes (standard)
- FP8 tensor cores: yes (new to Blackwell)
- INT8 tensor cores: yes
- W4 quantization support: native FP4 E2M1 format with CUTLASS

## Known Bottlenecks (from CLAUDE.md)
- CUTLASS FP4 GEMM (W4A4) @ decode(M=1): ~307 us per projection
- Marlin FP4 GEMV (W4A16) @ decode(M=1): ~52 us per projection (5.9x faster)
- Prefill (M=8192): Marlin becomes 3.8x slower than CUTLASS (kernel overhead)
- Crossover threshold: M≈48 (tuned via SGLANG_MARLIN_DECODE_THRESHOLD)

## Current Optimizations
1. Hybrid Marlin/CUTLASS dispatch (implemented)
2. Marlin: W4A16 (weights FP4, activations BF16)
3. CUTLASS: W4A4 (both weights & activations FP4)
4. FlashInfer ≥0.6.7.post3 for SM120 CUTLASS fix

## Alternative Approaches Not Yet Explored
1. FlashInfer GEMV kernels for W4A16
2. Triton W4A16 GEMV (attempted but 2.6x slower than CUTLASS)
3. Split-K dequantization + cuBLAS
4. FP8 mixed precision on-the-fly dequant
5. Optimized CUTLASS templates specific to decode (M<=256)
```

```
101	
102	    @cute.experimental.kernel
103	    def kernel(
104	        self,
105	        mA: cute.Tensor,
106	        mSFA: cute.Tensor,
107	        mB: cute.Tensor,
108	        mSFB: cute.Tensor,
109	        mC: cute.Tensor,
110	    ):
111	        # Prologue
112	        tidx, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
113	        warp_idx = cute.arch.warp_idx()
114	        warp_idx = cute.arch.make_warp_uniform(warp_idx)
115	        cta_m, cta_n, cta_l = cute.arch.block_idx()
116	
117	        a_dtype: Type[cutlass.Numeric] = mA.element_type
118	        sf_dtype: Type[cutlass.Numeric] = mSFA.element_type
119	        c_dtype: Type[cutlass.Numeric] = mC.element_type
120	        a_major_mode = utils.LayoutEnum.from_tensor(mA).mma_major_mode()
121	        b_major_mode = utils.LayoutEnum.from_tensor(mB).mma_major_mode()
122	        d_layout = utils.LayoutEnum.from_tensor(mC)
123	
124	        tiled_mma = sm100_utils.make_blockscaled_trivial_tiled_mma(
125	            a_dtype,
126	            a_major_mode,
127	            b_major_mode,
128	            sf_dtype,
129	            self.sf_vec_size,
130	            self.cta_group,
131	            self.mma_inst_shape_mn,
132	        )
133	
134	        mma_inst_shape_k = cute.size(tiled_mma.shape_mnk, mode=[2])
135	        mma_inst_tile_k = 4
136	        mma_tiler_mnk = (
137	            self.mma_inst_shape_mn[0],
138	            self.mma_inst_shape_mn[1],
139	            mma_inst_shape_k * mma_inst_tile_k,
140	        )
141	
142	        tiler_mk = (mma_tiler_mnk[0], mma_tiler_mnk[2])
143	        tiler_nk = (mma_tiler_mnk[1], mma_tiler_mnk[2])
144	        tiler_mn = (mma_tiler_mnk[0], mma_tiler_mnk[1])
145	
146	        # ((Atom_M, Rest_M),(Atom_K, Rest_K), RestL)
147	        sfa_layout = blockscaled_utils.tile_atom_to_shape_SF(mA.shape, self.sf_vec_size)
148	        sfa_tensor = cute.make_tensor(mSFA.iterator, sfa_layout)
149	
150	        # ((Atom_N, Rest_N),(Atom_K, Rest_K), RestL)
151	        sfb_layout = blockscaled_utils.tile_atom_to_shape_SF(mB.shape, self.sf_vec_size)
152	        sfb_tensor = cute.make_tensor(mSFB.iterator, sfb_layout)
153	
154	        gA = cute.zipped_divide(mA, tiler_mk)
155	        gB = cute.zipped_divide(mB, tiler_nk)
156	        gSFA = cute.zipped_divide(sfa_tensor, tiler_mk)
157	        gSFB = cute.zipped_divide(sfb_tensor, tiler_nk)
158	        gC = cute.zipped_divide(mC, tiler_mn)
159	
160	        gA_tile = gA[(None, None), (cta_m, None, cta_l)]
161	        gB_tile = gB[(None, None), (cta_n, None, cta_l)]
162	        gSFA_tile = gSFA[(None, None), (cta_m, None, cta_l)]
163	        gSFB_tile = gSFB[(None, None), (cta_n, None, cta_l)]
164	        gC_tile = gC[(None, None), (cta_m, cta_n, cta_l)]
165	
166	        # Shared memory layouts for A/B/SFA/SFB/D
167	        # (MMA, MMA_M, MMA_K, PIPE)
168	        a_smem_layout_staged = sm100_utils.make_smem_layout_a(
169	            tiled_mma,
170	            mma_tiler_mnk,
171	            self.ab_dtype,
172	            self.num_main_stages,
173	        )
174	
175	        # (MMA, MMA_N, MMA_K, PIPE)
176	        b_smem_layout_staged = sm100_utils.make_smem_layout_b(
177	            tiled_mma,
178	            mma_tiler_mnk,
179	            self.ab_dtype,
180	            self.num_main_stages,
181	        )
182	
183	        # (MMA, MMA_M, MMA_K, PIPE)
184	        sfa_smem_layout_staged = blockscaled_utils.make_smem_layout_sfa(
185	            tiled_mma,
186	            mma_tiler_mnk,
187	            self.sf_vec_size,
188	            self.num_main_stages,
189	        )
190	
191	        # (MMA, MMA_N, MMA_K, PIPE)
192	        sfb_smem_layout_staged = blockscaled_utils.make_smem_layout_sfb(
193	            tiled_mma,
194	            mma_tiler_mnk,
195	            self.sf_vec_size,
196	            self.num_main_stages,
197	        )
198	
199	        cta_tile_shape_mnk = cute.shape_div(
200	            mma_tiler_mnk, (cute.size(tiled_mma.thr_id.shape), 1, 1)
201	        )
202	        epi_tile = sm100_utils.compute_epilogue_tile_shape(
203	            cta_tile_shape_mnk,
204	            self.use_2cta_instrs,
205	            d_layout,
206	            c_dtype,
207	        )
208	        smem_epi_staged_layout = sm100_utils.make_smem_layout_epi(
209	            c_dtype,
210	            d_layout,
211	            epi_tile,
212	            self.tma_store_stages,
213	        )
214	
215	        # UMMA ACC TMEM Layout
216	        # ((MMA_M, MMA_N), REST_MMA_M, REST_MMA_N, ACC_STAGES)
217	        tmem_accs_layout = cute_ext.make_tmem_layout_acc(
218	            tiled_mma, mma_tiler_mnk, self.num_acc_stages
219	        )
220	
221	        sfa_tmem_layout = blockscaled_utils.make_tmem_layout_sfa(
222	            tiled_mma,
223	            mma_tiler_mnk,
224	            self.sf_vec_size,
225	            cute.slice_(sfa_smem_layout_staged, (None, None, None, 0)),
226	        )
227	
228	        sfb_tmem_layout = blockscaled_utils.make_tmem_layout_sfb(
229	            tiled_mma,
230	            mma_tiler_mnk,
231	            self.sf_vec_size,
232	            cute.slice_(sfb_smem_layout_staged, (None, None, None, 0)),
233	        )
234	
235	        # Allocate UMMA Buffers
236	        buffer_smem_a = cute_ext.allocate(
237	            self.ab_dtype,
238	            cute.AddressSpace.smem,
239	            a_smem_layout_staged,
240	            alignment=1024,
241	        )
242	
243	        buffer_smem_b = cute_ext.allocate(
244	            self.ab_dtype,
245	            cute.AddressSpace.smem,
246	            b_smem_layout_staged,
247	            alignment=1024,
248	        )
249	
250	        buffer_smem_sfa = cute_ext.allocate(
251	            self.sf_dtype,
252	            cute.AddressSpace.smem,
253	            sfa_smem_layout_staged,
254	            alignment=1024,
255	        )
256	
257	        buffer_smem_sfb = cute_ext.allocate(
258	            self.sf_dtype,
259	            cute.AddressSpace.smem,
260	            sfb_smem_layout_staged,
261	            alignment=1024,
262	        )
263	
264	        buffer_tmem_accs = cute_ext.allocate(
265	            self.acc_dtype,
266	            cute.AddressSpace.tmem,
267	            tmem_accs_layout,
268	            alignment=16,
269	        )
270	
271	        buffer_tmem_sfa = cute_ext.allocate(
272	            self.sf_dtype,
273	            cute.AddressSpace.tmem,
274	            sfa_tmem_layout,
275	            alignment=16,
276	        )
277	
278	        buffer_tmem_sfb = cute_ext.allocate(
279	            self.sf_dtype,
280	            cute.AddressSpace.tmem,
281	            sfb_tmem_layout,
282	            alignment=16,
283	        )
284	
285	        buffer_tmem_sfa_compact = cute.filter_zeros(buffer_tmem_sfa)
286	        buffer_tmem_sfb_compact = cute.filter_zeros(buffer_tmem_sfb)
287	
288	        # Make S2T CopyAtom and tiledCopy
289	        copy_atom_s2t = cute.make_copy_atom(
290	            tcgen05.Cp4x32x128bOp(self.cta_group),
291	            self.sf_dtype,
292	        )
293	
294	        tiled_copy_s2t_sfa = cute.nvgpu.tcgen05.make_s2t_copy(
295	            copy_atom_s2t, buffer_tmem_sfa_compact
296	        )
297	        tiled_copy_s2t_sfb = cute.nvgpu.tcgen05.make_s2t_copy(
298	            copy_atom_s2t, buffer_tmem_sfb_compact
299	        )
300	
301	        # Allocate SMEM buffer for C
302	        buffer_smem_d = cute_ext.allocate(
303	            c_dtype,
304	            cute.AddressSpace.smem,
305	            smem_epi_staged_layout,
306	            alignment=1024,
307	        )
308	
309	        # Create the TMEM load atom
310	        copy_atom_t2r = sm100_utils.get_tmem_load_op(
311	            cta_tile_shape_mnk,
312	            d_layout,
313	            c_dtype,
314	            self.acc_dtype,
315	            epi_tile,
316	            self.use_2cta_instrs,
317	        )
318	
319	        # Derive tiled_copy_t2r from the allocated TMEM buffer
320	        accumulators = cute.zipped_divide(buffer_tmem_accs, ((epi_tile), 1))
321	        acc_epi_div = accumulators[((None, None), 0), 0]
322	        tiled_copy_t2r = tcgen05.make_tmem_copy(copy_atom_t2r, acc_epi_div)
323	        thr_copy_t2r = tiled_copy_t2r.get_slice(tidx)
324	
325	        # Derive per-thread RMEM layout for the T2R epilogue copy
326	        gC_tile_epi = cute.flat_divide(gC_tile, epi_tile)
327	        acc_epi_rmem_layout = cute_ext.make_t2r_rmem_layout(
328	            tiled_copy_t2r, gC_tile_epi, tidx
329	        )
330	
331	        # Allocate RMEM buffers
332	        buffer_rmem_t2r = cute_ext.allocate(
333	            self.acc_dtype,
334	            cute.AddressSpace.rmem,
335	            acc_epi_rmem_layout,
336	            alignment=32,
337	        )
338	        buffer_rmem_r2s = cute_ext.allocate(
339	            c_dtype,
340	            cute.AddressSpace.rmem,
341	            acc_epi_rmem_layout,
342	            alignment=32,
343	        )
344	
345	        # TMA -> UMMA
346	        mainloop_pipe = cute_ext.TMAToUMMAPipeline.create(
347	            num_stages=self.num_main_stages,
348	            mma_operation_type=cute_ext.OperationTypeEnum.SM100_MMA_1SM_SS,
349	        )
350	
351	        # UMMA -> TMEM
352	        acc_pipe = cute_ext.UMMAtoAsyncPipeline.create(
353	            num_stages=self.num_acc_stages,
354	            mma_operation_type=cute_ext.OperationTypeEnum.SM100_MMA_1SM_SS,
355	            consumer=cute_ext.OperationTypeEnum.SM100_COPY_T2R,
356	            consumer_arv_count=128,
357	        )
358	
359	        # warp assignment: [0]-tma_store, [0-3]-epi, [4]-mma, [5]-tma_load
360	        tma_store_warp_id = 0
361	        mma_warp_id = 4
362	        tma_load_warp_id = 5
363	        is_tma_load_warp = warp_idx == tma_load_warp_id
364	        is_mma_warp = warp_idx == mma_warp_id
365	        is_epi_warp = warp_idx < 4
366	
367	        # SMEM -> GMEM
368	        tma_store_pipe = cute_ext.TMAStorePipeline(
369	            stages=self.tma_store_stages,
370	            arv_count=128,
371	            barrier_id=1,
372	            tma_warp_id=tma_store_warp_id,
373	        )
374	
375	        k_tile_size = cute.size(gA, mode=[1, 1])
376	
377	        if is_tma_load_warp:
378	            for k_tile_idx in cutlass.range(0, k_tile_size, 1, unroll=1):
379	                gA_k = gA_tile[None, None, k_tile_idx]
380	                gB_k = gB_tile[None, None, k_tile_idx]
381	                gSFA_k = gSFA_tile[None, None, k_tile_idx]
382	                gSFB_k = gSFB_tile[None, None, k_tile_idx]
383	
384	                # Scoped state management - pipeline object manages state internally
385	                (
386	                    producer_stage_token,
387	                    stage_idx,
388	                ) = mainloop_pipe.producer_acquire_and_get_stage()
389	                mbar = cute_ext.get_mbarrier(producer_stage_token)
390	                ## producer_body begin ##
391	                buffer_smem_a_sliced = buffer_smem_a[None, None, None, stage_idx]
392	                buffer_smem_b_sliced = buffer_smem_b[None, None, None, stage_idx]
393	                buffer_smem_sfa_sliced = buffer_smem_sfa[None, None, None, stage_idx]
394	                buffer_smem_sfb_sliced = buffer_smem_sfb[None, None, None, stage_idx]
395	
396	                a_cta_v_map = cute_ext.get_cta_v_map_ab(
397	                    mA, mma_tiler_mnk, tiled_mma, "A"
398	                )
399	                b_cta_v_map = cute_ext.get_cta_v_map_ab(
400	                    mB, mma_tiler_mnk, tiled_mma, "B"
401	                )
402	                sfa_cta_v_map = cute_ext.get_cta_v_map_ab(
403	                    sfa_tensor, mma_tiler_mnk, tiled_mma, "SFA"
404	                )
405	                sfb_cta_v_map = cute_ext.get_cta_v_map_ab(
406	                    sfb_tensor, mma_tiler_mnk, tiled_mma, "SFB"
407	                )
408	
409	                cute_ext.tma_load(
410	                    gA_k,
411	                    buffer_smem_a_sliced,
412	                    mbar,
413	                    cta_v_map=a_cta_v_map,
414	                )
415	                cute_ext.tma_load(
416	                    gB_k,
417	                    buffer_smem_b_sliced,
418	                    mbar,
419	                    cta_v_map=b_cta_v_map,
420	                )
421	                cute_ext.tma_load(
422	                    gSFA_k,
423	                    buffer_smem_sfa_sliced,
424	                    mbar,
425	                    cta_v_map=sfa_cta_v_map,
426	                )
427	                cute_ext.tma_load(
428	                    gSFB_k,
429	                    buffer_smem_sfb_sliced,
430	                    mbar,
431	                    cta_v_map=sfb_cta_v_map,
432	                )
433	                ## producer_body end ##
434	                mainloop_pipe.producer_commit_and_advance()
435	
436	        if is_mma_warp:
437	            producer_stage_token, acc_stage_idx = (
438	                acc_pipe.producer_acquire_and_get_stage()
439	            )
440	            ## acc_producer_body begin ##
441	            accumulators_sliced = buffer_tmem_accs[None, None, None, acc_stage_idx]
442	
443	            mma_atom = cute.make_mma_atom(tiled_mma.op)
444	            mma_atom.set(cute.nvgpu.tcgen05.Field.ACCUMULATE, False)
445	
446	            filtered_buffer_smem_sfa = cute.filter_zeros(buffer_smem_sfa)
447	            filtered_buffer_smem_sfb = cute.filter_zeros(buffer_smem_sfb)
448	
449	            for k_tile_idx in cutlass.range(0, k_tile_size, 1, unroll=1):
450	                # Scoped state management - pipeline object manages consumer state internally
451	                (
452	                    _,
453	                    mainloop_idx,
454	                ) = mainloop_pipe.consumer_wait_and_get_stage()
455	                ## tma_consumer_body begin ##
456	                buffer_smem_a_sliced_stage = buffer_smem_a[
457	                    (None, None, None, mainloop_idx)
458	                ]
459	                buffer_smem_b_sliced_stage = buffer_smem_b[
460	                    (None, None, None, mainloop_idx)
461	                ]
462	                filtered_buffer_smem_sfa_sliced_stage = filtered_buffer_smem_sfa[
463	                    (None, None, None, mainloop_idx)
464	                ]
465	                filtered_buffer_smem_sfb_sliced_stage = filtered_buffer_smem_sfb[
466	                    (None, None, None, mainloop_idx)
467	                ]
468	
469	                # Copy SFA/SFB from SMEM to TMEM (UTCCP)
470	                src_partitioned_SFA = cute_ext.partition(
471	                    filtered_buffer_smem_sfa_sliced_stage,
472	                    cute.Int32(0),
473	                    layout_tv=tiled_copy_s2t_sfa.layout_src_tv_tiled,
474	                    tiler=cute.core._pack_tile(tiled_copy_s2t_sfa.tiler_mn),
475	                )
476	                dst_partitioned_SFA = cute_ext.partition(
477	                    buffer_tmem_sfa_compact,
478	                    cute.Int32(0),
479	                    layout_tv=tiled_copy_s2t_sfa.layout_dst_tv_tiled,
480	                    tiler=cute.core._pack_tile(tiled_copy_s2t_sfa.tiler_mn),
481	                )
482	
483	                cute_ext.copy(
484	                    src_partitioned_SFA, dst_partitioned_SFA, copy_atom=copy_atom_s2t
485	                )
486	
487	                src_partitioned_SFB = cute_ext.partition(
488	                    filtered_buffer_smem_sfb_sliced_stage,
489	                    cute.Int32(0),
490	                    layout_tv=tiled_copy_s2t_sfb.layout_src_tv_tiled,
491	                    tiler=cute.core._pack_tile(tiled_copy_s2t_sfb.tiler_mn),
492	                )
493	                dst_partitioned_SFB = cute_ext.partition(
494	                    buffer_tmem_sfb_compact,
495	                    cute.Int32(0),
496	                    layout_tv=tiled_copy_s2t_sfb.layout_dst_tv_tiled,
497	                    tiler=cute.core._pack_tile(tiled_copy_s2t_sfb.tiler_mn),
498	                )
499	
500	                cute_ext.copy(
501	                    src_partitioned_SFB, dst_partitioned_SFB, copy_atom=copy_atom_s2t
502	                )
503	
504	                for k_block_idx in cutlass.range(mma_inst_tile_k, unroll_full=True):
505	                    buffer_smem_a_sliced = buffer_smem_a_sliced_stage[
506	                        None, None, k_block_idx
507	                    ]
508	                    buffer_smem_b_sliced = buffer_smem_b_sliced_stage[
509	                        None, None, k_block_idx
510	                    ]
511	
512	                    cute_ext.dot_block_scaled(
513	                        mma_atom,
514	                        cute.append_ones(buffer_smem_a_sliced, up_to_rank=3),
515	                        buffer_tmem_sfa[None, None, k_block_idx],
516	                        cute.append_ones(buffer_smem_b_sliced, up_to_rank=3),
517	                        buffer_tmem_sfb[None, None, k_block_idx],
518	                        accumulators_sliced,
519	                    )
520	                    mma_atom.set(cute.nvgpu.tcgen05.Field.ACCUMULATE, True)
521	
522	                ## tma_consumer_body end ##
523	                mainloop_pipe.consumer_release_and_advance()
524	
525	            ## acc_producer_body end ##
526	            acc_pipe.producer_commit_and_advance()
527	
528	        if is_epi_warp:
529	            _, acc_stage_idx = acc_pipe.consumer_wait_and_get_stage()
530	            ## acc_consume_body begin ##
531	            tmem_acc_stage = buffer_tmem_accs[
532	                (None, None), 0, 0, acc_stage_idx
533	            ]  # (MMA_M, MMA_N)
534	            # (EPI_TILE_M, EPI_TILE_N, EPI_REST_M, EPI_REST_N)
535	            # we have an implicit assumption that EPI_REST_M == 1
536	            tmem_acc_epi_stage = cute.flat_divide(tmem_acc_stage, epi_tile)
537	
538	            subtile_cnt = cute.size(tmem_acc_epi_stage.shape, mode=[3])  # EPI_REST_N
539	            for subtile_idx in range(subtile_cnt):
540	                # TMEM -> RMEM
541	                cute_ext.partition_and_copy(
542	                    thr_copy_t2r,
543	                    tmem_acc_epi_stage[(None, None, 0, subtile_idx)],
544	                    buffer_rmem_t2r,
545	                )
546	
547	                # RMEM -> RMEM
548	                buffer_rmem_r2s.store(
549	                    self.epilogue_op(buffer_rmem_t2r.load().to(c_dtype))
550	                )
551	
552	                # Acquire pipeline stage and synchronize before RMEM->SMEM copy
553	                tma_store_pipe.acquire_sync()
554	                tma_store_idx = tma_store_pipe.get_index()
555	
556	                # RMEM -> SMEM
557	                tiled_copy_r2s = cute.make_tiled_copy_D(
558	                    cute.make_copy_atom(cute.nvgpu.CopyUniversalOp(), c_dtype),
559	                    tiled_copy_t2r,
560	                )
561	                cute_ext.partition_and_copy(
562	                    tiled_copy_r2s.get_slice(tidx),
563	                    buffer_rmem_r2s,
564	                    buffer_smem_d[None, None, tma_store_idx],
565	                )
566	
567	                # Fence SMEM writes and synchronize before TMA store
568	                tma_store_pipe.commit_sync()
569	
570	                # SMEM -> GMEM (only designated TMA store warp performs TMA store)
571	                if warp_idx == tma_store_warp_id:
572	                    c_cta_v_map = cute_ext.get_cta_v_map_c(mC, epi_tile)
573	                    cute_ext.tma_store(
574	                        buffer_smem_d[None, None, tma_store_idx],
575	                        gC_tile_epi[(None, None, 0, subtile_idx)],
576	                        cta_v_map=c_cta_v_map,
577	                    )
578	
579	                # Release pipeline stage and advance
580	                tma_store_pipe.release_advance()
581	
582	            tma_store_pipe.tail()
583	            acc_pipe.consumer_release_and_advance()
584	
585	
586	@cute.experimental.jit
587	def cvt_sf_MKL_to_M32x4xrm_K4xrk_L(
588	    sf_ref_tensor: cute.Tensor,
589	    sf_mma_tensor: cute.Tensor,
590	):
591	    """
592	    Convert scale factor tensor from MKL layout to mma specification
593	    M(32x4xrest_m)xK(4xrest_k)xL layout
594	    """
595	    # sf_mma_tensor has flatten shape (32, 4, rest_m, 4, rest_k, l)
596	    # group to ((32, 4, rest_m), (4, rest_k), l)
597	    sf_mma_tensor = cute.group_modes(sf_mma_tensor, 0, 3)
598	    sf_mma_tensor = cute.group_modes(sf_mma_tensor, 1, 3)
599	    for i in cutlass.range(cute.size(sf_ref_tensor)):
600	        mkl_coord = sf_ref_tensor.layout.get_hier_coord(i)
601	        sf_mma_tensor[mkl_coord] = sf_ref_tensor[mkl_coord]
602	
603	
604	# TODO: add residual support (C)
605	@dataclass
606	class BlockScaledGemmTestbed:
607	    """
608	    Testbed for block-scaled GEMM operations on Blackwell (SM100) architecture.
609	
610	    This class manages test data and tensors for block-scaled matrix multiplication:
611	        D = (A * scale_factor_A) @ (B * scale_factor_B)
612	
613	    The testbed maintains three representations of each tensor:
614	    1. Reference tensors (f32 on CPU) - used for reference computation and validation
615	    2. CUTE tensors - device tensors passed directly to CUDA kernels
616	    3. PyTorch tensors - mirrors of CUTE tensors for host-side operations
617	
618	    Attributes:
619	        a_ref, b_ref: Reference input matrices (f32 format)
620	        sfa_ref, sfb_ref: Reference scale factors for A and B matrices (f32 format)
621	        d_ref: Reference output matrice (f32 format)
622	
623	        a_tensor, b_tensor: CUTE tensors for input matrices (device)
624	        sfa_tensor, sfb_tensor: CUTE tensors for scale factors (device)
625	        d_tensor: CUTE tensors for output (device)
626	
627	        a_torch, b_torch: PyTorch mirrors of A and B CUTE tensors
628	        sfa_torch, sfb_torch: PyTorch mirrors of scale factor CUTE tensors
629	        d_torch: PyTorch mirrors of D CUTE tensors
630	
631	    The class provides:
632	    - Automatic tensor creation with proper layouts and alignment
633	    - Scale factor tensor generation with block-scaled MMA layout
634	    - Reference checking via einsum-based computation
635	
636	    Example:
637	        testbed = BlockScaledGemmTestbed(
638	            MNKL=(128, 128, 64, 1),
639	            mma_dtypes=(cutlass.Float16, cutlass.Float16, cutlass.Float32),
640	            c_dtypes=(cutlass.Float16),
641	            sf_dtype=cutlass.Float16,
642	            sf_vec_size=32,
643	            a_major='m', b_major='n', d_major='m'
644	        )
645	        # ... run kernel with testbed.a_tensor, testbed.b_tensor, etc.
646	        testbed.reference_check()  # Validate results
647	    """
648	
649	    import torch
650	
651	    # Reference tensors (all are in f32 format for simplicity of
652	    # reference checks)
653	    a_ref: torch.Tensor
654	    b_ref: torch.Tensor
655	    sfa_ref: torch.Tensor
656	    sfb_ref: torch.Tensor
657	
658	    # CUTE tensors (to be passed to the device kernel)
659	    a_tensor: cute.Tensor
660	    b_tensor: cute.Tensor
661	    sfa_tensor: cute.Tensor
662	    sfb_tensor: cute.Tensor
663	    d_tensor: cute.Tensor
664	
665	    # PyTorch tensors (mirrors the CUTE tensors above); these tensors
666	    # can be used on the host, for example if certain trivial epilogue
667	    # needs to be performed.
668	    a_torch: torch.Tensor
669	    b_torch: torch.Tensor
670	    sfa_torch: torch.Tensor
671	    sfb_torch: torch.Tensor
672	    d_torch: torch.Tensor
673	
674	    def __init__(
675	        self,
676	        MNKL: Tuple[int, int, int, int],
677	        mma_dtypes: tuple[
678	            Type[cutlass.Numeric], Type[cutlass.Numeric], Type[cutlass.Numeric]
679	        ],
680	        c_dtype: Type[cutlass.Numeric],
681	        sf_dtype: Type[cutlass.Numeric],
682	        sf_vec_size: int,
683	        a_major: str,
684	        b_major: str,
685	        d_major: str,
686	    ):
687	        import cutlass.torch as cutlass_torch
688	
689	        self.d_major = d_major
690	
691	        # Problem size
692	        (M, N, K, L) = MNKL
693	
694	        a_dtype, b_dtype, _ = mma_dtypes
695	
696	        assert a_major in ("m", "k"), f"a_major must be 'm' or 'k', got {a_major}"
697	        assert b_major in ("n", "k"), f"b_major must be 'n' or 'k', got {b_major}"
698	        assert d_major in ("m", "n"), f"d_major must be 'm' or 'n', got {d_major}"
699	
700	        self.a_ref = cutlass_torch.matrix(L, M, K, a_major == "m", cutlass.Float32)
701	        self.b_ref = cutlass_torch.matrix(L, N, K, b_major == "n", cutlass.Float32)
702	        self.d_temp = cutlass_torch.matrix(L, M, N, d_major == "m", cutlass.Float32)
703	
704	        self.a_tensor, self.a_torch = cutlass_torch.cute_tensor_like(
705	            self.a_ref, a_dtype, is_dynamic_layout=True, assumed_align=16
706	        )
707	        self.b_tensor, self.b_torch = cutlass_torch.cute_tensor_like(
708	            self.b_ref, b_dtype, is_dynamic_layout=True, assumed_align=16
709	        )
710	        self.d_tensor, self.d_torch = cutlass_torch.cute_tensor_like(
711	            self.d_temp, c_dtype, is_dynamic_layout=True, assumed_align=16
712	        )
713	
714	        # Mark tensor with element divisibility for 16B alignment
715	        self.a_tensor.mark_compact_shape_dynamic(
716	            mode=1 if a_major == "k" else 0,
717	            stride_order=(2, 0, 1) if a_major == "k" else (2, 1, 0),
718	            divisibility=32 if a_dtype == cutlass.Float4E2M1FN else 16,
719	        )
720	        self.b_tensor.mark_compact_shape_dynamic(
721	            mode=1 if b_major == "k" else 0,
722	            stride_order=(2, 0, 1) if b_major == "k" else (2, 1, 0),
723	            divisibility=32 if b_dtype == cutlass.Float4E2M1FN else 16,
724	        )
725	        self.d_tensor.mark_compact_shape_dynamic(
726	            mode=1 if d_major == "k" else 0,
727	            stride_order=(2, 0, 1) if d_major == "n" else (2, 1, 0),
728	            divisibility=32 if c_dtype == cutlass.Float4E2M1FN else 16,
729	        )
730	
731	        self.sfa_ref, self.sfa_tensor, self.sfa_torch = self.create_scale_factor_tensor(
732	            L, M, K, sf_vec_size, sf_dtype
733	        )
734	        self.sfb_ref, self.sfb_tensor, self.sfb_torch = self.create_scale_factor_tensor(
735	            L, N, K, sf_vec_size, sf_dtype
736	        )
737	
738	    # Create scale factor tensor
739	    @staticmethod
740	    def create_scale_factor_tensor(l, mn, k, sf_vec_size, dtype):
741	        import torch
742	        import cutlass.torch as cutlass_torch
743	
744	        def ceil_div(a, b):
745	            return (a + b - 1) // b
746	
747	        sf_k = ceil_div(k, sf_vec_size)
748	        ref_shape = (l, mn, sf_k)
749	        ref_permute_order = (1, 2, 0)  # MKL
750	
751	        atom_m = (32, 4)
752	        atom_k = 4
753	        mma_shape = (
754	            l,
755	            ceil_div(mn, atom_m[0] * atom_m[1]),
756	            ceil_div(sf_k, atom_k),
757	            atom_m[0],
758	            atom_m[1],
759	            atom_k,
760	        )
761	        mma_permute_order = (3, 4, 1, 5, 2, 0)  # M(32x4xrest_m)xK(4xrest_k)xL
762	
763	        # Create f32 ref torch tensor (cpu)
764	        ref_f32_torch_tensor_cpu = cutlass_torch.create_and_permute_torch_tensor(
765	            ref_shape,
766	            torch.float32,
767	            permute_order=ref_permute_order,
768	            init_type=cutlass_torch.TensorInitType.RANDOM,
769	            init_config=cutlass_torch.RandomInitConfig(
770	                min_val=1,
771	                max_val=3,
772	            ),
773	        )
774	
775	        # Create f32 cute torch tensor (cpu)
776	        cute_f32_torch_tensor_cpu = cutlass_torch.create_and_permute_torch_tensor(
777	            mma_shape,
778	            torch.float32,
779	            permute_order=mma_permute_order,
780	            init_type=cutlass_torch.TensorInitType.RANDOM,
781	            init_config=cutlass_torch.RandomInitConfig(
782	                min_val=0,
783	                max_val=1,
784	            ),
785	        )
786	
787	        # convert ref f32 tensor to cute f32 tensor
788	        cvt_sf_MKL_to_M32x4xrm_K4xrk_L(
789	            from_dlpack(ref_f32_torch_tensor_cpu),
790	            from_dlpack(cute_f32_torch_tensor_cpu),
791	        )
792	        cute_f32_torch_tensor = cute_f32_torch_tensor_cpu.cuda()
793	
794	        # reshape makes memory contiguous
795	        ref_f32_torch_tensor_cpu = (
796	            ref_f32_torch_tensor_cpu.permute(2, 0, 1)
797	            .unsqueeze(-1)
798	            .expand(l, mn, sf_k, sf_vec_size)
799	            .reshape(l, mn, sf_k * sf_vec_size)
800	            .permute(*ref_permute_order)
801	        )
802	        # prune to mkl for reference check.
803	        ref_f32_torch_tensor_cpu = ref_f32_torch_tensor_cpu[:, :k, :]
804	
805	        # Create dtype cute torch tensor (cpu)
806	        cute_tensor, cute_torch_tensor = cutlass_torch.cute_tensor_like(
807	            cute_f32_torch_tensor_cpu,
808	            dtype,
809	            is_dynamic_layout=True,
810	            assumed_align=16,
811	        )
812	
813	        # Convert f32 cute tensor to dtype cute tensor
814	        cute_tensor = cutlass_torch.convert_cute_tensor(
815	            cute_f32_torch_tensor,
816	            cute_tensor,
817	            dtype,
818	            is_dynamic_layout=True,
819	        )
820	        return ref_f32_torch_tensor_cpu, cute_tensor, cute_torch_tensor
821	
822	    # Transfers results back to CPU and uses PyTorch's methods to do
823	    # reference checks
824	    def reference_check(self):
825	        import torch
826	
827	        # Compute reference result, simulate block-scaled GEMV via 2 FFMA
828	        # based elementwise multiplication and 1 FFMA based matmul computations
829	        res_a = torch.einsum("mkl,mkl->mkl", self.a_ref, self.sfa_ref)
830	        res_b = torch.einsum("nkl,nkl->nkl", self.b_ref, self.sfb_ref)
831	        ref_output = torch.einsum("mkl,nkl->mnl", res_a, res_b)
832	
833	        # Convert d back to f32 for comparison.
834	        d_epi_device = self.d_temp.cuda()
835	        cute.testing.convert(
836	            self.d_tensor,
837	            from_dlpack(d_epi_device, assumed_align=16).mark_layout_dynamic(
838	                leading_dim=(1 if self.d_major == "n" else 0)
839	            ),
840	        )
841	
842	        # abs(actual - expected) <= atol + rtol * abs(expected)
843	        torch.testing.assert_close(
844	            d_epi_device.cpu(), ref_output, atol=1e-01, rtol=1e-02
845	        )
846	        print("Reference check finished.")
847

849	def run(
850	    mnkl: Tuple[int, int, int, int],
851	    mma_inst_mn: Tuple[int, int],
852	    cluster_shape_mn: Tuple[int, int],
853	    ab_dtype: Type[cutlass.Numeric],
854	    sf_dtype: Type[cutlass.Numeric],
855	    sf_vec_size: int,
856	    d_dtype: Type[cutlass.Numeric],
857	    acc_dtype: Type[cutlass.Numeric],
858	    a_major: str,
859	    b_major: str,
860	    d_major: str,
861	):
862	    """Execute a batched block scaled dense GEMM operation on Blackwell architecture.
863	
864	    This function prepares input tensors, configures and launches the GEMM kernel,
865	    and performs reference validation.
866	
867	    :param mnkl: Problem size (M, N, K, L)
868	    :type mnkl: Tuple[int, int, int, int]
869	    :param mma_inst_mn: MMA instruction shape.
870	    :type mma_inst_mn: Tuple[int, int]
871	    :param cluster_shape_mn: Cluster shape.
872	    :type cluster_shape_mn: Tuple[int, int]
873	    :param ab_dtype: Data type for input tensors A and B
874	    :type ab_dtype: Type[Numeric]
875	    :param sf_dtype: Data type for scale factors (SFA/SFB)
876	    :type sf_dtype: Type[Numeric]
877	    :param sf_vec_size: Vector size for the scale factor
878	    :type sf_vec_size: int
879	    :param c_dtype: Data type for output tensor D
880	    :type c_dtype: Type[Numeric]
881	    :param acc_dtype: Accumulator data type (precision)
882	    :type acc_dtype: Type[Numeric]
883	    :param a_major: Major-ness of A tensor (m or k)
884	    :type a_major: str
885	    :param b_major: Major-ness of B tensor (n or k)
886	    :type b_major: str
887	    :param d_major: Major-ness of D tensor (m or n)
888	    :type d_major: str
889	    """
890	    print("Running Blackwell Dense Block Scaled GEMM test with:")
891	    print(f"mnkl: {mnkl}")
892	    print(f"A: {ab_dtype}, B: {ab_dtype}, D: {d_dtype}, Acc dtype: {acc_dtype}")
893	    print(f"Block scaled MMA with SF: {sf_dtype}, vector size: {sf_vec_size}")
894	    print(f"Matrix majors - A: {a_major}-major, B: {b_major}-major, D: {d_major}-major")
895	    print(
896	        f"Mma Tiler (M, N): {mma_inst_mn}, Cluster Shape: {cluster_shape_mn[0]}x{cluster_shape_mn[1]}x1"
897	    )
898	    import torch
899	
900	    # TODO: add can_implement to exclude unsupported/un-implemented test cases
901	    if cluster_shape_mn != (1, 1):
902	        raise RuntimeError("Only 1x1x1 cluster shapes are supported right now.")
903	    if mma_inst_mn != (128, 128):
904	        raise RuntimeError("MMA instruction shape not supported yet.")
905	    if ab_dtype not in (cutlass.Float8E4M3FN, cutlass.Float8E5M2):
906	        raise RuntimeError("Input data type not supported.")
907	    if sf_dtype not in (cutlass.Float8E8M0FNU, cutlass.Float8E4M3FN):
908	        raise RuntimeError("Scale factor data type not supported.")
909	
910	    if not torch.cuda.is_available():
911	        raise RuntimeError("A GPU is required to run this example!")
912	
913	    # Manual seed
914	    torch.manual_seed(111)
915	
916	    # Create tensors
917	    tb = BlockScaledGemmTestbed(
918	        mnkl,
919	        (ab_dtype, ab_dtype, acc_dtype),
920	        d_dtype,
921	        sf_dtype,
922	        sf_vec_size,
923	        a_major,
924	        b_major,
925	        d_major,
926	    )
927	
928	    # JIT-Compile the device kernel
929	    block_scaled_gemm = BlockScaledDenseGemmKernel(
930	        mma_inst_mn=mma_inst_mn,
931	        mma_dtype=(ab_dtype, acc_dtype),
932	        sf_dtype=sf_dtype,
933	        sf_vec_size=sf_vec_size,
934	    )
935	
936	    compiled_kernel = cute.experimental.compile(
937	        block_scaled_gemm,
938	        tb.a_tensor,
939	        tb.sfa_tensor,
940	        tb.b_tensor,
941	        tb.sfb_tensor,
942	        tb.d_tensor,
943	    )
944	
945	    # Launch the device kernel
946	    compiled_kernel(
947	        tb.a_tensor,
948	        tb.sfa_tensor,
949	        tb.b_tensor,
950	        tb.sfb_tensor,
951	        tb.d_tensor,
952	    )
953	
954	    tb.reference_check()
```

```
22	def prepare_inputs(M, K, N):
23	    """Quantize random bf16 tensors to NVFP4 format."""
24	    a_bf16 = torch.randn(M, K, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda") * 0.5
25	    w_bf16 = torch.randn(N, K, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda") * 0.1
26	    gsf = torch.tensor([1.0], dtype=torch.float32, device="cuda")
27	    a_fp4, a_sf = flashinfer.nvfp4_quantize(a_bf16, gsf)
28	    w_fp4, w_sf = flashinfer.nvfp4_quantize(w_bf16, gsf)
29	    # flashinfer wants weight transposed
30	    wt = w_fp4.t().contiguous()
31	    wst = w_sf.t().contiguous()
32	    alpha = torch.tensor([1.0], dtype=torch.float32, device="cuda")
33	    # Reference output in bf16
34	    ref = (a_bf16.float() @ w_bf16.float().t()).bfloat16()
35	    return a_fp4, wt, a_sf, wst, alpha, ref
36

40	    # Correctness check first
41	    try:
42	        out = flashinfer.mm_fp4(
43	            a_fp4, wt, a_sf, wst,
44	            alpha=alpha, out_dtype=torch.bfloat16, backend=backend,
45	        )
46	    except Exception as e:
47	        return None, str(e)

54	        )

57	    start = torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True)
58	    end = torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True)
59	    torch.cuda.synchronize()

61	    for _ in range(REPEAT):

65	        )

67	    torch.cuda.synchronize()
68	    elapsed_ms = start.elapsed_time(end) / REPEAT

72	def compute_bandwidth(M, K, N, time_ms):
73	    """Compute effective bandwidth in GB/s.
74	
75	    Data moved: A_fp4 (M*K/2) + W_fp4 (K*N/2) + A_sf (M*K/16*f32=M*K/4) + W_sf (N*K/16*f32=N*K/4) + out (M*N*2)
76	    For M=1 decode, weight dominates: ~K*N/2 bytes for fp4 weights.
77	    """
78	    # FP4 packed: 4 bits per element = 0.5 bytes
79	    a_bytes = M * K // 2
80	    w_bytes = K * N // 2
81	    # Scale factors: 1 float32 per 16 elements
82	    a_sf_bytes = M * (K // 16) * 4
83	    w_sf_bytes = N * (K // 16) * 4
84	    # Output: bf16
85	    out_bytes = M * N * 2
86	    total_bytes = a_bytes + w_bytes + a_sf_bytes + w_sf_bytes + out_bytes
87	    bw_gb_s = total_bytes / (time_ms * 1e-3) / 1e9
88	    return total_bytes, bw_gb_s
89

95	    print()

98	    PEAK_BW = 1152.0
```

```
1	"""NVFP4-to-FP8 decode benchmark.
2	
3	Pre-dequantizes NVFP4 weights to FP8 e4m3fn at "load time", then uses
4	torch._scaled_mm for M=1 decode.  Compares latency and correctness against
5	the NVFP4 CUTLASS baseline (flashinfer mm_fp4).
6	
7	Key insight: torch._scaled_mm needs row-major A (M,K) and col-major B (K,N).
8	We store w_fp8 as (N,K) contiguous, then pass w_fp8.t() which gives a (K,N)
9	col-major view -- exactly what scaled_mm wants.
10	"""
11	
12	import time
13	import torch
14	from flashinfer import fp4_quantize, mm_fp4
15	
16	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
17	# FP4 E2M1 look-up table (index 0..15 -> float value)
18	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
19	FP4_LUT = [0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0, 6.0,
20	           0, -0.5, -1.0, -1.5, -2.0, -3.0, -4.0, -6.0]
21	
22	
23	def nvfp4_dequant_to_bf16(qw: torch.Tensor,
24	                           scales: torch.Tensor,
25	                           global_scale: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
26	    """Dequantize NVFP4 packed weights to BF16.
27	
28	    Args:
29	        qw: (N, K//2) uint8 -- two FP4 values per byte (lo nibble, hi nibble)
30	        scales: (N, K//16) uint8 -- FP8 e4m3fn block scales
31	        global_scale: (1,) float32
32	
33	    Returns:
34	        (N, K) bfloat16 tensor
35	    """
36	    lut = torch.tensor(FP4_LUT, dtype=torch.float32, device=qw.device)
37	
38	    lo = (qw & 0x0F).to(torch.int64)
39	    hi = ((qw >> 4) & 0x0F).to(torch.int64)
40	
41	    N, half_K = qw.shape
42	    K = half_K * 2
43	
44	    w_f32 = torch.empty(N, K, device=qw.device, dtype=torch.float32)
45	    w_f32[:, 0::2] = lut[lo]
46	    w_f32[:, 1::2] = lut[hi]
47	
48	    # Block scales: each FP8 scale covers 16 consecutive K elements
49	    scales_f32 = scales.view(torch.float8_e4m3fn).to(torch.float32)  # (N, K//16)
50	    scales_exp = scales_f32.repeat_interleave(16, dim=1)  # (N, K)
51	
52	    w_f32.mul_(scales_exp).mul_(global_scale.item())
53	    return w_f32.to(torch.bfloat16)
54	
55	
56	def bf16_to_fp8_with_scale(w_bf16: torch.Tensor):
57	    """Convert BF16 tensor to FP8 e4m3fn with per-tensor scale.
58	
59	    Returns:
60	        w_fp8: (N, K) float8_e4m3fn  (contiguous, row-major)
61	        scale: scalar float32 tensor on same device
62	    """
63	    amax = w_bf16.float().abs().amax()
64	    # FP8 e4m3fn max representable value is 448.0
65	    fp8_max = 448.0
66	    scale = (amax / fp8_max).clamp(min=1e-12)
67	    w_scaled = (w_bf16.float() / scale).clamp(-fp8_max, fp8_max)
68	    w_fp8 = w_scaled.to(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
69	    return w_fp8, scale.to(torch.float32)
70	
71	
72	def bench_fn(fn, warmup=30, iters=300):
73	    """Benchmark a function, return mean latency in microseconds."""
74	    torch.cuda.synchronize()
75	    for _ in range(warmup):
76	        fn()
77	    torch.cuda.synchronize()
78	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
79	    for _ in range(iters):
80	        fn()
81	    torch.cuda.synchronize()
82	    return (time.perf_counter() - t0) / iters * 1e6
83	
84	
85	def main():
86	    torch.manual_seed(0)
87	    device = "cuda"
88	
89	    # Model dimensions
90	    h, inter = 4096, 16384
91	    nq, nkv, hd = 32, 2, 128
92	
93	    projections = [
94	        ("qkv_proj",  h,     (nq + 2 * nkv) * hd),   # K=4096, N=4608
95	        ("o_proj",    nq * hd, h),                      # K=4096, N=4096
96	        ("gate_up",   h,     2 * inter),                # K=4096, N=32768
97	        ("down_proj", inter, h),                        # K=16384, N=4096
98	    ]
99	
100	    gs = torch.tensor([1.0], dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
101	
102	    hdr = (f"{'proj':10s} {'K':>6s} {'N':>6s} | "
103	           f"{'CUTLASS':>9s} {'FP8_mm':>9s} {'BF16':>9s} | "
104	           f"{'speedup':>7s} | {'max_err':>8s} {'cos_sim':>7s}")
105	    print(hdr)
106	    print("-" * len(hdr))
107	
108	    total_cutlass_us = 0.0
109	    total_fp8_us = 0.0
110	    total_bf16_us = 0.0
111	    total_nvfp4_bytes = 0
112	    total_fp8_bytes = 0
113	
114	    results = []
115	
116	    for name, K, N in projections:
117	        # --- Generate random BF16 weight and quantize to NVFP4 ---
118	        w_bf16 = torch.randn(N, K, device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
119	        qw, scales = fp4_quantize(w_bf16, global_scale=gs)
120	
121	        # --- NVFP4 memory ---
122	        nvfp4_bytes = qw.numel() * qw.element_size() + scales.numel() * scales.element_size()
123	        total_nvfp4_bytes += nvfp4_bytes
124	
125	        # --- Dequantize NVFP4 -> BF16 -> FP8 (one-time "load" cost) ---
126	        w_deq_bf16 = nvfp4_dequant_to_bf16(qw, scales, gs)
127	        w_fp8, w_scale = bf16_to_fp8_with_scale(w_deq_bf16)
128	        # w_fp8 is (N, K) contiguous row-major
129	        # For torch._scaled_mm: A (M,K) row-major @ B (K,N) col-major
130	        # B col-major = w_fp8.t()  where w_fp8 is (N,K) contiguous
131	
132	        fp8_bytes = w_fp8.numel() * w_fp8.element_size()
133	        total_fp8_bytes += fp8_bytes
134	
135	        # --- Prepare inputs ---
136	        x_bf16 = torch.randn(1, K, device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
137	
138	        # FP8 input for scaled_mm
139	        x_fp8, x_scale = bf16_to_fp8_with_scale(x_bf16)
140	        x_fp8 = x_fp8.contiguous()  # (1, K) row-major
141	
142	        # NVFP4 CUTLASS inputs
143	        qwt = qw.T.contiguous()
144	        st = scales.T.contiguous()
145	        x4, xs = fp4_quantize(x_bf16, global_scale=gs)
146	
147	        # Scale tensors for scaled_mm (must be float32, 1-element)
148	        sa = x_scale.view(1).to(device)
149	        sb = w_scale.view(1).to(device)
150	
151	        # --- BF16 reference ---
152	        y_ref = torch.mm(x_bf16, w_bf16.t())
153	
154	        # --- CUTLASS NVFP4 ---
155	        y_cutlass = mm_fp4(x4, qwt, xs, st, gs, torch.bfloat16, backend="cutlass")
156	
157	        # --- FP8 scaled_mm ---
158	        # w_fp8 is (N,K) contiguous; w_fp8.t() is (K,N) col-major view
159	        y_fp8 = torch._scaled_mm(
160	            x_fp8, w_fp8.t(),
161	            scale_a=sa, scale_b=sb,
162	            out_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
163	        )
164	
165	        # --- Correctness ---
166	        # Compare FP8 result against BF16 reference
167	        diff_fp8 = (y_fp8.float() - y_ref.float()).abs()
168	        max_err_fp8 = diff_fp8.max().item()
169	        cos_fp8 = torch.nn.functional.cosine_similarity(
170	            y_fp8.float().view(1, -1), y_ref.float().view(1, -1)
171	        ).item()
172	
173	        diff_cutlass = (y_cutlass.float() - y_ref.float()).abs()
174	        max_err_cutlass = diff_cutlass.max().item()
175	
176	        # --- Benchmark ---
177	        cutlass_us = bench_fn(
178	            lambda: mm_fp4(x4, qwt, xs, st, gs, torch.bfloat16, backend="cutlass")
179	        )
180	        fp8_us = bench_fn(

182	        )
183	        bf16_us = bench_fn(lambda: torch.mm(x_bf16, w_bf16.t()))
184	
185	        speedup = cutlass_us / fp8_us if fp8_us > 0 else 0
186	
187	        total_cutlass_us += cutlass_us
188	        total_fp8_us += fp8_us
189	        total_bf16_us += bf16_us
190	
191	        results.append((name, K, N, cutlass_us, fp8_us, bf16_us, speedup,
192	                         max_err_fp8, cos_fp8, max_err_cutlass))
193	
194	        print(f"{name:10s} {K:6d} {N:6d} | "
195	              f"{cutlass_us:7.1f}us {fp8_us:7.1f}us {bf16_us:7.1f}us | "
196	              f"{speedup:6.2f}x | "
197	              f"{max_err_fp8:8.2f} {cos_fp8:7.4f}")
```
